+import math
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+
+# -- The computer ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 478.0, 290.0, 62.0
+DECK = ((5.0, 27.0), (112.0, 40.0))     # the deck's front and back edges, (y, z)
+SLOPE = math.atan2(DECK[1][1] - DECK[0][1], DECK[1][0] - DECK[0][0])
+BAND = ((114.0, 45.0), (150.0, 60.0))   # the band's face: its front (bottom) and back (top) edges, (y, z)
+GROOVE = (152.0, 157.0, 3.0)            # between the band and the raised back: y0, y1, depth
+FOOT = 3.0                              # the dark foot band under the case
+
+
+def profile():
+    """The computer's side outline, (y, z), anticlockwise seen from its right end."""
+    (fy, fz), (by, bz) = BAND
+    return [(3.0, 0.0), (DEPTH - 3.0, 0.0), (DEPTH, 3.0), (DEPTH, HEIGHT - 5.0), (DEPTH - 5.0, HEIGHT),
+            (by + 2.0, HEIGHT), (by, bz), (fy, fz), (DECK[1][0], DECK[1][1]), DECK[0], (0.0, DECK[0][1] - 4.0),
+            (0.0, 3.0)]
+
+
+def deck_point(s, h):
+    """The model's (y, z) of the point s up the deck's slope from its front edge and h off it."""
+    c, k = math.cos(SLOPE), math.sin(SLOPE)
+    return DECK[0][0] + s * c - h * k, DECK[0][1] + s * k + h * c
+
+
+BAND_SLOPE = math.atan2(BAND[1][1] - BAND[0][1], BAND[1][0] - BAND[0][0])
+
+
+def band_point(s, h):
+    """The model's (y, z) of the point s up the band's face from its bottom edge and h off it."""
+    c, k = math.cos(BAND_SLOPE), math.sin(BAND_SLOPE)
+    return BAND[0][0] + s * c - h * k, BAND[0][1] + s * k + h * c
+
+
+VENT = dict(x=(-226.0, 226.0), y=(165.0, 283.0), depth=1.6, pitch=7.6, width=3.4)   # the ribbed panel on the top
+DRIVE = dict(slot=(176.0, 268.0, 28.0, 33.0), bulge=(205.0, 239.0, 26.0, 37.0), depth=30.0,  # y0, y1, z0, z1

+    + _row(["np_lpar", "np_rpar", "np_slash", "np_star"], PAD_U, 1, ["(", ")", "/", "*"])
+    + _row(["np7", "np8", "np9", "np_minus"], PAD_U, 2, ["7", "8", "9", "-"])
+    + _row(["np4", "np5", "np6", "np_plus"], PAD_U, 3, ["4", "5", "6", "+"])
+    + _row(["np1", "np2", "np3"], PAD_U, 4, ["1", "2", "3"])

+)
+RETURN = dict(top=(13.5, 14.5), foot=(12.75, 14.5))       # its two rows' x, in units: row 3's foot the wider
+
+
+def return_outline():
+    """RETURN's base, an (x, s) outline anticlockwise from its foot's front left corner."""

+    s3, s2, s1 = ROW_S[3] + g, ROW_S[2] + g, ROW_S[2] + U - g
+    return [(kx(c) + g, s3), (kx(b) - g, s3), (kx(b) - g, s1), (kx(a) + g, s1), (kx(a) + g, s2), (kx(c) + g, s2)]

+def wells():

+    body=dict(back=(270.0, 196.0), depth=236.0, lift=30.0),     # the body: its back's width and height; the whole

+trash; the floppy's window open over it, ODYSSEY.PRG chosen; and the title screen of a made-up game, Odyssey), and the
+floppy's two sides. Run it with the system Python (Pillow):
+
+    python tools/console-models/atari_st_print.py <out folder>
+
+It writes atari_st_print.png and atari_st_media.png there.
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import atari_st_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from msx_layout import inset  # noqa: E402
+from psp_print import ship  # noqa: E402
+from retro_pc_print import rgb, shade  # noqa: E402
+from windows_pc_print import FONTS, Region  # noqa: E402
+
+CASE = rgb(L.COLOURS["case"])
+LEGEND = (70, 68, 62)
+BLUE = (40, 120, 220)
+
+
+def top_point(x, y):
+    """A point of the computer (x from its middle, y back from its front) in the top region's millimetres."""
+    return x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.DEPTH - y
+
+
+def fuji(reg, x, y, size, colour):
+    """Atari's mark, size tall, its middle at (x, y): three columns, the outer two flaring out at their feet."""
+    s = size
+    reg.rect_(x - 0.08 * s, y - 0.5 * s, x + 0.08 * s, y + 0.5 * s, colour)
+    for side in (-1, 1):
+        pts = [(x + side * 0.16 * s, y - 0.5 * s), (x + side * 0.3 * s, y - 0.5 * s), (x + side * 0.3 * s, y - 0.05 * s),
+               (x + side * 0.58 * s, y + 0.5 * s), (x + side * 0.4 * s, y + 0.5 * s), (x + side * 0.16 * s, y + 0.05 * s)]
+        reg.poly(pts, colour)
+
+
+def slanted(reg, text, font, size, x, y, fill, shear=0.18, anchor="lm"):
+    layer = reg.layer()
+    f = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + font, max(1, round(size * reg.sx)))
+    ImageDraw.Draw(layer).text(reg.p(x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill + (255,), anchor=anchor)
+    yc = reg.p(0, y)[1]
+    reg.over(layer.transform(layer.size, Image.AFFINE, (1, shear, -shear * yc, 0, 1, 0)))
+
+
+def badge_plate(reg, x0, y0, x1, y1, model):
+    """The slanted plate: Atari's mark and ATARI in blue, the model in black, on silver."""
+    lean = (y1 - y0) * 0.9
+    reg.poly([(x0 + lean, y0), (x1, y0), (x1 - lean, y1), (x0, y1)], (224, 226, 228))
+    h = y1 - y0
+    fuji(reg, x0 + lean + 2.6, (y0 + y1) / 2, h * 0.62, (30, 30, 34))
+    slanted(reg, "ATARI", "arialbd.ttf", h * 0.8, x0 + lean + 6.4, (y0 + y1) / 2, BLUE, shear=0.0)
+    slanted(reg, model, "arialbd.ttf", h * 0.82, x1 - lean - 1.0, (y0 + y1) / 2, (30, 30, 34), anchor="rm")
+
+
+# ---- The computer's top ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def deck_top(points, h):
+    """An (x, s) outline on the deck, raised h off it, in the top region's millimetres."""
+    return [top_point(x, L.deck_point(s, h)[0]) for x, s in points]
+
+
+def key_top(reg, name, outline, legend):
+    fill = rgb(L.COLOURS["top_keys"])
+    xs = [x for x, _ in outline]
+    ss = [s for _, s in outline]
+    i = L.KEY_INSET
+    inner = [(min(xs) + i, min(ss) + i), (max(xs) - i, min(ss) + i), (max(xs) - i, max(ss) - i), (min(xs) + i, max(ss) - i)]
+    if name == "return":
+        inner = inset(outline, i)
+    pts = deck_top(inner, L.KEY_HEIGHT)
+    reg.poly(pts, fill)
+    xs = [x for x, _ in pts]
+    ys = [y for _, y in pts]
+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys)
+    if name != "return":
+        reg.rect_(x0 + 0.9, y0 + 0.9, x1 - 0.9, y1 - 0.9, shade(fill, 0.04), r=1.2)
+    if not legend:
+        return
+    lines = legend.split("\n")
+    if name == "return":
+        x0 = top_point(L.kx(L.RETURN["foot"][0]), 0.0)[0]
+        y0 = deck_top([(0.0, L.ROW_S[3] + L.U - i)], L.KEY_HEIGHT)[0][1]
+        reg.text("Return", "arial.ttf", 2.1, x0 + 1.8, y0 + 2.6, LEGEND, anchor="lm")
+        return
+    if len(lines) == 1 and len(legend) == 1 and not legend.isalnum() and name.startswith(("up", "down", "left", "right")):
+        reg.text(legend, "seguisym.ttf", 3.6, (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, LEGEND)
+        return
+    if len(lines) == 1 and len(legend) == 1:
+        reg.text(legend, "arial.ttf", 3.6 if legend.isalpha() else 3.2, (x0 + x1) / 2 if name.startswith("np")
+                 else x0 + 2.6, (y0 + y1) / 2 if name.startswith("np") else y0 + 3.0, LEGEND)
+        return
+    size = 2.1 if max(len(line) for line in lines) > 2 else 2.8
+    for k, line in enumerate(lines):
+        reg.text(line, "arial.ttf", size, x0 + 1.6, y0 + 2.4 + k * (size + 1.1), LEGEND, anchor="lm")
+
+
+def band_top(points):
+    """An (x, s) outline on the band's face, in the top region's millimetres."""
+    return [top_point(x, L.band_point(s, 0.0)[0]) for x, s in points]
+
+
+def fkey_outline(k):
+    f = L.FKEYS
+    x0 = f["x0"] + k * f["width"]
+    x1 = x0 + f["width"] - f["gap"]
+    (s0, s1), lean = f["s"], f["lean"]
+    return [(x0, s0), (x1, s0), (x1 + lean, s1), (x0 + lean, s1)]
+
+
+def top():
+    reg = Region(L.PRINT_REGIONS["top"], L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH, CASE)
+    (vx0, vx1), (vy0, vy1) = L.VENT["x"], L.VENT["y"]
+    vent = rgb(L.COLOURS["vent"])
+    reg.rect_(*top_point(vx0, vy1), *top_point(vx1, vy0), vent)
+    layer = reg.layer()                                     # the grooves' floors, darker, at 45 degrees (x - y constant)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    h = L.VENT["width"] / math.sqrt(2)
+    c = vx0 - vy1
+    while c < vx1 - vy0:
+        d.polygon([reg.p(*top_point(x, y)) for x, y in ((vy0 + c - h, vy0), (vy0 + c + h, vy0), (vy1 + c + h, vy1),
+                                                         (vy1 + c - h, vy1))], fill=shade(vent, -0.3) + (255,))
+        c += L.VENT["pitch"] * math.sqrt(2)
+    mask = Image.new("L", layer.size, 0)
+    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rectangle(reg.box(*top_point(vx0, vy1), *top_point(vx1, vy0)), fill=255)
+    reg.img.paste(layer, (0, 0), Image.composite(layer.getchannel("A"), Image.new("L", layer.size, 0), mask))
+    for name, xu, row, wu, legend, *rest in L.KEYS:
+        x0, s0, x1, s1 = L.key_rect(xu, row, wu, rest[0] if rest else 1)
+        key_top(reg, name, [(x0, s0), (x1, s0), (x1, s1), (x0, s1)], legend)
+    key_top(reg, "return", L.return_outline(), "Return")
+
+    # The function keys: slanted blades, each a shade lighter at its top, its name at its foot.
+    for k in range(10):
+        pts = band_top(fkey_outline(k))
+        reg.poly(pts, shade(CASE, 0.08))
+        a, b = pts[0], pts[1]
+        reg.line([a, b], shade(CASE, -0.3), 0.3)
+        reg.text(f"F{k + 1}", "arial.ttf", 1.9, (pts[0][0] + pts[3][0]) / 2 + 4.0, (pts[0][1] + pts[3][1]) / 2 + 0.6,
+                 shade(CASE, -0.25))
+
+    (bx0, bx1), (bs0, bs1) = L.BADGE["x"], L.BADGE["s"]
+    (_, by1), (_, by0) = top_point(0, L.band_point(bs0, 0)[0]), top_point(0, L.band_point(bs1, 0)[0])
+    badge_plate(reg, top_point(bx0, 0)[0], by0, top_point(bx1, 0)[0], by1, "520STFM")
+    w, d = L.LIGHTS["size"]
+    for name, colour, on in (("drive", (110, 48, 30), False), ("power", (120, 255, 110), True)):
+        x, s = L.LIGHTS[name]
+        y = L.band_point(s, 0)[0] if name == "drive" else L.deck_point(s, 0)[0]
+        cx, cy = top_point(x, y)
+        if on:
+            glow = reg.layer()
+            ImageDraw.Draw(glow).rounded_rectangle(reg.box(cx - w / 2 - 2, cy - d - 1, cx + w / 2 + 2, cy + d + 1),
+                                                   radius=2 * reg.sx, fill=colour + (110,))
+            reg.over(glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(1.2 * reg.sx)))
+        reg.rect_(cx - w / 2, cy - d / 2, cx + w / 2, cy + d / 2, colour, r=0.4)
+    return reg
+
+
+def monitor_badge():
+    b = L.MONITOR["badge"]
+    w, h = b["x"][1] - b["x"][0], b["z"][1] - b["z"][0]
+    reg = Region(L.PRINT_REGIONS["badge"], w, h, rgb(L.COLOURS["monitor"]))
+    fuji(reg, 4.0, h / 2, h * 0.6, (40, 40, 44))
+    reg.text("ATARI", "arialbd.ttf", h * 0.62, 8.0, h / 2, BLUE, anchor="lm")
+    lean = h * 0.7
+    reg.poly([(44.0 + lean, 1.5), (w - 2.0, 1.5), (w - 2.0 - lean, h - 1.5), (44.0, h - 1.5)], (205, 208, 206))
+    slanted(reg, "SC1224", "arialbd.ttf", h * 0.6, w - 6.0 - lean, h / 2, (70, 72, 76), anchor="rm")
+    return reg
+
+
+def mouse_top():
+    w, d, _ = L.MOUSE["size"]
+    reg = Region(L.PRINT_REGIONS["mouse"], w, d, rgb(L.COLOURS["case"]))
+    b = L.MOUSE["buttons"]
+    reg.rect_(0.0, 0.0, w, b, shade(CASE, 0.05))
+    reg.rect_(w / 2 - 0.4, 0.0, w / 2 + 0.4, b, shade(CASE, -0.35))
+    reg.rect_(0.0, b - 0.4, w, b + 0.4, shade(CASE, -0.35))
+    fuji(reg, w / 2, d - 20.0, 9.0, shade(CASE, -0.2))
+    return reg
+
+
+def print_atlas(out):
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (L.ATLAS, L.ATLAS), CASE)
+    for reg in (top(), monitor_badge(), mouse_top()):
+        reg.paste(image)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
+    for name, colour in (("lit", (255, 150, 60)), ("off", (110, 48, 30)), ("green", (120, 255, 110)),
+                         ("dark", rgb(L.COLOURS["dark"])), ("vent", rgb(L.COLOURS["vent"])),
+                         ("monitor", rgb(L.COLOURS["monitor"]))):
+        x, y = L.PRINT_SWATCHES[name]
+        d.rectangle([x - 12, y - 12, x + 11, y + 11], fill=colour)
+    path = os.path.join(out, "atari_st_print.png")
+    image.save(path, optimize=True)
+    print(path)
+

+# ---- The screens -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+WHITE, BLACK = (255, 255, 255), (0, 0, 0)
+GREEN = (0, 219, 0)                    # the ST's desktop green: 0, 7, 0 on its 3-bit scale, a shade under full
+FONT = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "consolab.ttf", 9)
+
+
+def st_text(d, x, y, s, fill):
+    d.text((x, y), s, font=FONT, fill=fill, anchor="lm")
+
+
+def pointer(d, x, y):
+    arrow = [(0, 0), (0, 11), (3, 8), (5, 13), (7, 12), (5, 7), (9, 7)]
+    d.polygon([(x + a, y + b) for a, b in arrow], fill=BLACK, outline=WHITE)
+
+
+def caption(d, x, y, text, inverted=False):
+    w = len(text) * 5 + 4
+    d.rectangle([x - w // 2, y - 4, x + w // 2, y + 4], fill=BLACK if inverted else WHITE)
+    small = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "consola.ttf", 7)
+    d.text((x, y), text, font=small, fill=WHITE if inverted else BLACK, anchor="mm")
+
+
+def disk_icon(d, x, y, letter):
+    """TOS's floppy disk: a drawer, its slot and its letter, its name under it."""
+    d.rectangle([x - 12, y - 10, x + 12, y + 8], fill=WHITE, outline=BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x - 9, y - 7, x + 9, y + 1], outline=BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x - 5, y + 3, x + 5, y + 5], fill=BLACK)
+    st_text(d, x - 2, y - 3, letter, BLACK)
+    caption(d, x, y + 15, "FLOPPY DISK")
+
+
+def trash_icon(d, x, y):
+    d.rectangle([x - 8, y - 12, x + 8, y - 10], fill=WHITE, outline=BLACK)
+    d.polygon([(x - 7, y - 9), (x + 7, y - 9), (x + 6, y + 8), (x - 6, y + 8)], fill=WHITE, outline=BLACK)
+    for k in (-3, 0, 3):
+        d.line([(x + k, y - 6), (x + k, y + 5)], fill=BLACK)
+    caption(d, x, y + 15, "TRASH")
+
+
+def desktop(with_pointer=True):
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (320, 200), GREEN)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    d.fontmode = "1"
+    d.rectangle([0, 0, 319, 9], fill=WHITE)
+    d.line([(0, 9), (319, 9)], fill=BLACK)
+    for x, word in ((4, "Desk"), (40, "File"), (76, "View"), (112, "Options")):
+        st_text(d, x, 5, word, BLACK)
+    disk_icon(d, 24, 30, "A")
+    disk_icon(d, 24, 70, "B")
+    trash_icon(d, 24, 172)
+    if with_pointer:
+        pointer(d, 196, 112)
+    return img
+
+
+def window():
+    img = desktop(with_pointer=False)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    d.fontmode = "1"
+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = 70, 26, 300, 150
+    d.rectangle([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=WHITE, outline=BLACK)
+    for k in range(0, 9, 2):                               # the title bar's stripes
+        d.line([(x0 + 11, y0 + 1 + k), (x1 - 11, y0 + 1 + k)], fill=BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x0 + 120 - 16, y0 + 1, x0 + 120 + 16, y0 + 9], fill=WHITE)
+    st_text(d, x0 + 109, y0 + 5, "A:\\", BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x0, y0, x0 + 10, y0 + 10], fill=WHITE, outline=BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x0 + 3, y0 + 3, x0 + 7, y0 + 7], outline=BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x1 - 10, y0, x1, y0 + 10], fill=WHITE, outline=BLACK)
+    d.line([(x0, y0 + 10), (x1, y0 + 10)], fill=BLACK)
+    small = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "consola.ttf", 8)
+    d.text((x0 + 4, y0 + 15), "61440 bytes used in 3 items.", font=small, fill=BLACK, anchor="lm")
+    d.line([(x0, y0 + 20), (x1, y0 + 20)], fill=BLACK)
+    d.line([(x1 - 10, y0 + 20), (x1 - 10, y1)], fill=BLACK)
+    d.rectangle([x1 - 9, y0 + 32, x1 - 1, y0 + 70], fill=(170, 170, 170))
+    d.line([(x0, y1 - 10), (x1, y1 - 10)], fill=BLACK)
+
+    def icon(cx, cy, kind, name, chosen=False):
+        ink, paper = (WHITE, BLACK) if chosen else (BLACK, WHITE)
+        if kind == "prg":
+            d.rectangle([cx - 11, cy - 10, cx + 11, cy + 8], fill=paper, outline=ink)
+            d.rectangle([cx - 11, cy - 10, cx + 11, cy - 6], fill=ink)
+        elif kind == "txt":
+            d.polygon([(cx - 8, cy - 10), (cx + 4, cy - 10), (cx + 8, cy - 6), (cx + 8, cy + 8), (cx - 8, cy + 8)],
+                      fill=paper, outline=ink)
+            for k in range(4):
+                d.line([(cx - 5, cy - 4 + 3 * k), (cx + 5, cy - 4 + 3 * k)], fill=ink)
+        else:
+            d.polygon([(cx - 11, cy - 6), (cx - 4, cy - 6), (cx - 2, cy - 9), (cx + 11, cy - 9), (cx + 11, cy + 8),
+                       (cx - 11, cy + 8)], fill=paper, outline=ink)
+        caption(d, cx, cy + 15, name, inverted=chosen)
+    icon(x0 + 34, y0 + 46, "prg", "ODYSSEY.PRG", chosen=True)
+    icon(x0 + 94, y0 + 46, "txt", "READ_ME.TXT")
+    icon(x0 + 154, y0 + 46, "dir", "SAVES")
+    pointer(d, x0 + 40, y0 + 44)
+    return img
+
+
+def title_screen():
+    """Odyssey's title screen, 320 x 200: the sky banded as the ST's 3-bit palette bands it, stars, a ringed planet,
+    the ship, the title in raster-bar colours, PRESS FIRE."""
+    w, h = 320, 200
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (w, h))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    d.fontmode = "1"
+    stops = [(0.0, (0, 0, 2)), (0.5, (3, 0, 5)), (0.8, (6, 1, 4)), (1.0, (7, 4, 2))]   # 0-7 per channel
+    for y in range(h):
+        t = y / h
+        for (t0, c0), (t1, c1) in zip(stops, stops[1:]):
+            if t0 <= t <= t1:
+                u = (t - t0) / (t1 - t0)
+                colour = tuple(round(a + (b - a) * u) * 255 // 7 for a, b in zip(c0, c1))
+        d.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=colour)
+    rng = random.Random(1040)
+    for _ in range(80):
+        x, y = rng.randrange(w), rng.randrange(120)
+        d.point((x, y), fill=(255, 255, 255) if rng.random() < 0.5 else (146, 182, 255))
+    d.ellipse([206, 96, 300, 190], fill=(255, 109, 36))
+    d.ellipse([212, 100, 284, 166], fill=(255, 146, 72))
+    d.arc([174, 128, 332, 158], 160, 380, fill=(255, 219, 182), width=3)
+    ship(d, 118, 140, 2.0, (255, 255, 255), (255, 182, 0))
+    for k in range(4):
+        d.line([(46 - k * 8, 136 + k * 3), (86 - k * 5, 136 + k * 3)], fill=(255, 219, 109), width=2)
+    font = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "ariblk.ttf", 40)
+    mask = Image.new("L", (w, 60), 0)
+    dm = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
+    dm.fontmode = "1"
+    dm.text((w / 2, 30), "ODYSSEY", font=font, fill=255, anchor="mm")
+    bars = Image.new("RGB", (w, 60))
+    db = ImageDraw.Draw(bars)
+    for y in range(60):                                       # the raster bars through the letters
+        t = abs(math.sin(y / 60 * math.pi * 2.0))
+        db.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=(255, round(73 + 182 * t) // 36 * 36, round(255 * (1 - t)) // 36 * 36))
+    img.paste((36, 0, 73), (2, 14), mask)
+    img.paste(bars, (0, 12), mask)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    d.fontmode = "1"
+    d.text((w / 2, 178), "PRESS FIRE TO START", font=ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "consolab.ttf", 11),
+           fill=(255, 255, 109), anchor="mm")
+    return img
+
+
+def glass_image(raster, size):
+    """A screen's region: the tube's dark border, the 320 x 200 picture in its middle."""
+    sw, sh = L.SCREEN_PX
+    rw, rh = L.RASTER
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (sw, sh), (20, 22, 21))
+    picture = raster.resize((rw * 2, rh * 2), Image.NEAREST).resize((rw, rh), Image.LANCZOS)
+    image.paste(picture, ((sw - rw) // 2, (sh - rh) // 2))
+    return image.resize(size, Image.LANCZOS)

+# ---- The floppy ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

+def disk_side(rect, label):

+    the label (the label side) or the hub."""
+    grey = rgb(L.COLOURS["disk"])

+    reg.circle(88.0, 7.0, 2.2, (16, 16, 20))
+    if label:
+        reg.rect_(39.0, 5.5, 92.0, 84.5, (240, 238, 230), r=1.2)
+        art = Image.new("RGB", (790, 530), (240, 238, 230))

+        da.rectangle([0, 0, 790, 150], fill=(30, 60, 160))

+        da.text((480, 75), "ODYSSEY", font=ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "ariblk.ttf", 96), fill=(255, 230, 90),
+                anchor="mm")
+        da.text((395, 240), "ATARI ST  ·  DISK 1", font=ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "arialbd.ttf", 50),
+                fill=(40, 40, 60), anchor="mm")
+        for y in (330, 400, 470):
+            da.line([(50, y), (740, y)], fill=(180, 176, 168), width=4)
+        art = art.rotate(90, expand=True)
+        x0, y0, x1, y1 = reg.box(40.0, 6.5, 91.0, 83.5)
+        reg.img.paste(art.resize((round(x1 - x0), round(y1 - y0)), Image.LANCZOS), (round(x0), round(y0)))
+        reg.poly([(3.0, 6.0), (8.0, 3.5), (8.0, 8.5)], shade(grey, 0.35))
+    else:
+        cx, cy = 52.0, 45.0
+        reg.circle(cx, cy, 14.5, shade(grey, -0.25))

+        reg.rect_(cx - 2.2, cy - 2.2, cx + 2.2, cy + 2.2, (30, 30, 34))

+        reg.rect_(86.0, 79.0, 91.0, 86.0, (230, 230, 232), r=0.6)

+
+
+def media_atlas(out):
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (L.ATLAS, L.ATLAS), (20, 22, 21))
+    for name, raster in (("desktop", desktop()), ("window", window()), ("title", title_screen())):
+        x, y, w, h = L.MEDIA_REGIONS[name]
+        image.paste(glass_image(raster, (w, h)), (x, y))

+    image.save(path, optimize=True)
+    print(path)

+
+def main(out):
+    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)

+"""The console theme's BBC Micro system model (godot/themes/console/models/systems/bbcmicro.glb): the BBC Micro Model B,
+a twin disk drive on it and a Microvitec Cub monitor on the drive.
+
+Built in Blender (bbcmicro_layout.py has the measurements, taken from photographs). The computer is its case (its
+plan's corners rounded, its top's edges softened) with the keyboard panel sunk into its front half, the clear strip
+along the panel's back, the blank plate and the keys standing in the panel, each key a frustum, its top printed with its
+legend. The drive is a box on the computer's back half, its two slots cut into its front, a latch on each; the monitor
+a box on the drive, the bezel printed on its front and the tube's recess cut into it, the tube's face curved. The
+printing is one texture (bbcmicro_print.py's), projected from above onto the panel and the keys and from in front onto
+the drive's and the monitor's fronts.
+
+A node tree: a root (the turn to a three-quarter view, TILT_YAW and TILT_PITCH: the right end towards the viewer, the
+top tipped up; then the model spec's fit: standing on y = 0, centred, the largest side 1 m) holding the set; the set
+holding the floppy (waiting in front of drive 0, shrunk to nothing), drive 0's latch and light (shrunk to nothing while
+it's off), the tube's four faces (those not shown a little behind the one that is) and the keys the clip presses
+(SHIFT, BREAK, RETURN, Z, X and the space bar).
+
+The `focused` clip (8 s, looping): the floppy slides into drive 0 and the latch turns down; SHIFT and BREAK boot it, the
+drive's light flickers and the title comes up in teletext; SPACE, and the game's played in Mode 2 on Z, X and RETURN;
+BREAK brings the boot screen back, the latch turns up and the floppy slides out.
+
+Four materials (case, keys, screen, floppy) and one 1024² texture, within the system model budget. Run from the repo
+root:
+
+    python tools/console-models/bbcmicro_print.py artifacts/bbcmicro
+    blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/console-models/bbcmicro.py -- artifacts/bbcmicro godot/themes/console/models/systems/bbcmicro.glb
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Matrix, Vector
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import bbcmicro_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from amiga import curved, paint, rounded, solid  # noqa: E402
+from clip import HIDDEN, Pose, back_out, ease_in, key, phase, smooth  # noqa: E402
+from mega_drive_cartridge import bevel, boolean, box, export, join, material, triangles  # noqa: E402
+
+TILT_YAW = -24.0     # degrees about the vertical: the right end comes towards the viewer
+TILT_PITCH = 16.0    # degrees about the horizontal: the top tips up towards the viewer
+ROUGHNESS = dict(case=0.55, keys=0.35, screen=0.3, floppy=0.4)
+TOP = L.FEET + L.HEIGHT                      # the computer's top
+FLOOR = TOP - L.PANEL["depth"]               # the keyboard panel's floor
+DRIVE_TOP = TOP + L.DRIVE["height"]
+MOVING = {"SHIFT": "shift", "BREAK": "break", "RETURN": "return", "Z": "z", "X": "x", " ": "space"}
+
+
+def atlas_uv(region, w, h):
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = region
+    return lambda a, b: ((rx + a / w * rw) / L.ATLAS, 1 - (ry + b / h * rh) / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def swatch(name):
+    x, y = L.SWATCHES[name]
+    return lambda co: (x / L.ATLAS, 1 - y / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def colour(obj, mat, name):
+    paint(obj, mat, swatch(name), lambda c, n, kind: True)
+    return obj
+
+
+def upright(name, points, z0, z1, mat):
+    return solid(name, [[(x, y, z) for x, y in points] for z in (z0, z1)], mat)
+
+
+(PX0, PX1), (PY0, PY1) = L.PANEL["x"], L.PANEL["y"]
+PANEL = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["panel"], PX1 - PX0, PY1 - PY0)
+
+
+def panel_uv(co):
+    return PANEL(co.x - PX0, PY1 - co.y)
+
+
+# ---- The computer ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def computer(m):
+    """The case with the panel sunk in, the strip, the plate, the feet; printed."""
+    case = upright("bbcmicro", rounded(0.0, L.DEPTH / 2, L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH, 8.0, 4), L.FEET, TOP, m["case"])
+    bevel(case, 3.0, segments=2, angle=40)
+    boolean(case, box("panel", PX0, PX1, PY0, PY1, FLOOR, TOP + 5.0, m["case"]))
+    colour(case, m["case"], "case")
+    paint(case, m["case"], panel_uv, lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9 and abs(c.z - FLOOR) < 0.5)
+    paint(case, m["case"], swatch("black"),
+          lambda c, n, kind: abs(n.z) < 0.5 and PX0 - 0.5 < c.x < PX1 + 0.5 and PY0 - 0.5 < c.y < PY1 + 0.5
+          and c.z > FLOOR - 0.5)
+    s0, s1 = L.STRIP["y"]
+    strip = box("strip", PX0, PX1, s0, s1, FLOOR - 0.5, TOP - 1.5, m["case"])
+    colour(strip, m["case"], "black")
+    paint(strip, m["case"], panel_uv, lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9)
+    (p0, p1), (q0, q1) = L.PLATE["x"], L.PLATE["y"]
+    plate = box("plate", p0, p1, q0, q1, FLOOR - 0.5, FLOOR + 5.0, m["case"])
+    colour(plate, m["case"], "dark")
+    paint(plate, m["case"], panel_uv, lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9)
+    feet = [colour(box("foot", x - 12.0, x + 12.0, y - 8.0, y + 8.0, 0.0, L.FEET + 0.5, m["case"]), m["case"], "dark")
+            for x in (-170.0, 170.0) for y in (30.0, 320.0)]
+    return join([case, strip, plate] + feet, "bbcmicro")
+
+
+def keys(m):
+    """The keys: those the clip presses apart (each its foot's middle at its origin, with where it goes), the rest
+    joined."""
+    fixed, moving = [], {}
+    shifts = 0
+    for legend, tone, x0, x1, y in L.keys():
+        bottom = [(x, yy) for x, yy in ((x0 + 0.6, y - 9.0), (x1 - 0.6, y - 9.0), (x1 - 0.6, y + 9.0),
+                                       (x0 + 0.6, y + 9.0))]
+        top = [(x, yy) for x, yy in ((x0 + 2.8, y - 6.8), (x1 - 2.8, y - 6.8), (x1 - 2.8, y + 6.8),
+                                     (x0 + 2.8, y + 6.8))]
+        part = solid("key", [[(x, yy, FLOOR) for x, yy in bottom],
+                             [(x, yy, FLOOR + L.KEYS["height"]) for x, yy in top]], m["keys"])
+        colour(part, m["keys"], tone)
+        paint(part, m["keys"], panel_uv, lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9)
+        name = MOVING.get(legend)
+        if legend == "SHIFT":
+            shifts += 1
+            name = "shift" if shifts == 1 else None
+        if name:
+            middle = Vector(((x0 + x1) / 2, y, FLOOR))
+            part.data.transform(Matrix.Translation(-middle))
+            moving[name] = (part, middle)
+        else:
+            fixed.append(part)
+    return join(fixed, "keys"), moving
+
+
+# ---- The drive and the monitor ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def drive(m):
+    """The twin drive on the computer: its box, its slots cut in, drive 1's latch; its front printed."""
+    d = L.DRIVE
+    w, depth, h, y0 = d["width"], d["depth"], d["height"], d["y"]
+    part = upright("drive", rounded(0.0, y0 + depth / 2, w, depth, 6.0, 3), TOP, DRIVE_TOP, m["case"])
+    bevel(part, 2.0, segments=2, angle=40)
+    sw, sh = L.BAYS["slot"]
+    zc = TOP + L.BAYS["z"]
+    for x in L.BAYS["x"]:
+        boolean(part, box("slot", x - sw / 2, x + sw / 2, y0 - 5.0, y0 + 40.0, zc - sh / 2, zc + sh / 2, m["case"]))
+    colour(part, m["case"], "case")
+    face = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["drive"], w, h)
+    paint(part, m["case"], lambda co: face(co.x + w / 2, DRIVE_TOP - co.z),
+          lambda c, n, kind: n.y < -0.9 and c.y < y0 + 1.0)
+    paint(part, m["case"], swatch("black"),
+          lambda c, n, kind: c.y > y0 + 0.5 and abs(c.z - zc) < sh / 2 + 0.5 and any(abs(c.x - x) < sw / 2 + 0.5
+                                                                                     for x in L.BAYS["x"]))
+    latch = latch_part(m)
+    latch.data.transform(Matrix.Translation((L.BAYS["x"][1], y0 - 2.0, zc)))
+    return join([part, latch], "drive")
+
+
+def latch_part(m):
+    """A drive's latch, open (lying along the slot), its middle at its origin."""
+    lw, lh = L.BAYS["latch"]
+    part = box("latch", -lw / 2, lw / 2, -4.0, 0.0, -lh / 2, lh / 2, m["keys"])
+    bevel(part, 1.0, segments=1)
+    return colour(part, m["keys"], "grey")
+
+
+def monitor(m):
+    """The monitor on the drive: its box, the tube's recess cut into its front; its bezel printed."""
+    mon = L.MONITOR
+    w, h, depth, y0 = mon["width"], mon["height"], mon["depth"], L.DRIVE["y"]
+    part = upright("monitor", rounded(0.0, y0 + depth / 2, w, depth, 6.0, 3), DRIVE_TOP, DRIVE_TOP + h, m["case"])
+    bevel(part, 3.0, segments=2, angle=40)
+    sw, sh = L.SCREEN["size"]
+    zc = DRIVE_TOP + L.SCREEN["z"]
+    boolean(part, solid("recess", [[(x, y, z) for x, z in rounded(0.0, zc, sw + 16.0, sh + 16.0, 18.0, 5)]
+                                   for y in (y0 - 5.0, y0 + 14.0)], m["case"]))
+    colour(part, m["case"], "monitor")
+    face = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["bezel"], w, h)
+    paint(part, m["case"], lambda co: face(co.x + w / 2, DRIVE_TOP + h - co.z),
+          lambda c, n, kind: n.y < -0.9 and c.y < y0 + 1.0)
+    paint(part, m["case"], swatch("bezel"),
+          lambda c, n, kind: y0 + 0.5 < c.y < y0 + 14.5 and abs(c.x) < sw / 2 + 9.0
+          and abs(c.z - zc) < sh / 2 + 9.0)
+    return part
+
+
+def screen(m, name):
+    """One of the tube's faces, its middle at its origin, facing the viewer."""
+    sw, sh = L.SCREEN["size"]
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = L.REGIONS[name]
+    return curved(name, sw, sh, L.SCREEN["bulge"], lambda a, b: ((rx + a * rw) / L.ATLAS, 1 - (ry + b * rh) / L.ATLAS),
+                  m["screen"], 16, 12)
+
+
+def floppy(m):
+    """The floppy, lying flat, its middle at its origin, its label up and towards the viewer, going in along +y."""
+    s, t = L.FLOPPY["size"], L.FLOPPY["thickness"]
+    part = box("floppy", -s / 2, s / 2, -s / 2, s / 2, -t / 2, t / 2, m["floppy"])
+    colour(part, m["floppy"], "floppy")
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["floppy"], s, s)
+    paint(part, m["floppy"], lambda co: top(co.x + s / 2, co.y + s / 2), lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9)
+    return part
+
+
+# ---- The focused clip ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+SCREENS = ("boot", "title", "game_1", "game_2")
+BEHIND = 1.5              # how far back the tube's faces not shown wait
+
+
+def tap(f, f0, hold=2):
+    return smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 3)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f0 + 3 + hold, f0 + 7 + hold)))
+
+
+def shown(f):
+    if f < 60 or f >= 188:
+        return "boot"
+    if f < 100:
+        return "title"
+    return "game_1" if ((f - 100) // 8) % 2 == 0 else "game_2"
+
+
+def timeline(f):
+    out = L.FLOPPY["out"]
+    if f < 8 or f >= 232:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, scale=HIDDEN)
+    elif f < 14:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, scale=max(HIDDEN, back_out(phase(f, 8, 13))))
+    elif f < 34:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 14, 34))))
+    elif f < 204:
+        disk = Pose()
+    elif f < 224:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out * smooth(phase(f, 204, 224)))
+    else:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, scale=max(HIDDEN, 1 - ease_in(phase(f, 224, 232))))
+    shut = smooth(phase(f, 36, 42)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 196, 202)))
+    reading = 52 <= f < 92 and (f // 3) % 4 != 3
+    poses = {"floppy": disk, "latch": Pose(roll=90.0 * shut), "drive_light": Pose() if reading else Pose(scale=HIDDEN)}
+    for name in SCREENS:
+        poses[name] = Pose() if name == shown(f) else Pose(y=BEHIND)
+    press = -2.6
+    poses["shift"] = Pose(z=press * smooth(phase(f, 44, 47)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 53, 56))))
+    poses["break"] = Pose(z=press * max(tap(f, 48), tap(f, 184)))
+    poses["space"] = Pose(z=press * tap(f, 96))
+    poses["z"] = Pose(z=press * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in (108, 132, 156)))
+    poses["x"] = Pose(z=press * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in (120, 144, 168)))
+    poses["return"] = Pose(z=press * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in (116, 140, 162)))
+    return poses
+
+
+# ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
+    images, out = os.path.abspath(args[0]), os.path.abspath(args[1])
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.render.fps = L.FPS
+    atlas = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "bbcmicro_print.png"))
+    m = {name: material(name, L.COLOURS["print"], r, atlas) for name, r in ROUGHNESS.items()}
+
+    fixed_keys, moving_keys = keys(m)
+    whole = join([computer(m), fixed_keys, drive(m), monitor(m)], "bbcmicro")
+    for p in whole.data.polygons:
+        p.use_smooth = True
+    whole.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("bbcmicro_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    y0 = L.DRIVE["y"]
+    zc = TOP + L.BAYS["z"]
+    x0 = L.BAYS["x"][0]
+    lw, lh = L.BAYS["latch"]
+    light = colour(box("drive_light", -1.6, 1.6, -0.6, 0.0, -1.6, 1.6, m["keys"]), m["keys"], "lit")
+    bw, bh = L.BAYS["size"]
+    parts = {"floppy": (floppy(m), Vector((x0, y0 + L.FLOPPY["size"] / 2 + 4.0, zc))),
+             "latch": (latch_part(m), Vector((x0, y0 - 2.0, zc))),
+             "drive_light": (light, Vector((x0 - bw / 2 + 10.0, y0 - 0.2, zc - bh / 2 + 8.0)))}
+    sz = DRIVE_TOP + L.SCREEN["z"]
+    for name in SCREENS:
+        parts[name] = (screen(m, name), Vector((0.0, y0 + 13.5, sz)))
+    parts.update(moving_keys)
+    nodes = {}
+    for name, (part, where) in parts.items():
+        for p in part.data.polygons:
+            p.use_smooth = True
+        part.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+        nodes[name] = part
+
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole] + list(nodes.values())
+    print(f"BBC Micro: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The BBC Micro card's measurements, shared by bbcmicro_print.py (which draws its printing and screens) and
+bbcmicro.py (which builds it). Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+
+The BBC Micro Model B (1981), 409 mm wide, 358 deep and 78 high (the Home Computer Hall of Fame's figures), a twin
+5.25-inch disk drive on its back half and a Microvitec Cub colour monitor on the drive, 352 wide, 300 high and 415 deep
+(the Science Museum Group's record of one from the BBC's own collection), stacked as schools had them; a made-up game,
+Odyssey, on the floppy. Millimetres: x from the middle (left to right), y back from the computer's front, z up from the
+table. The computer was measured from photographs of Model Bs on Wikimedia Commons (from above and in front, at an
+angle), its keys on the 19.05 mm pitch; the monitor from the Science Museum Group's photograph of it.
+
+The computer: the beige case, the black keyboard panel sunk into its front half; along the panel's back the clear strip
+(the speaker's grille at its left, BRITISH BROADCASTING CORPORATION MICROCOMPUTER SYSTEM and the owl at its right); the
+red function keys f0 to f9 and BREAK, the keys in five rows (the cursor keys and COPY brown), the space bar; the blank
+plate at the panel's left, the three lights (cassette motor, caps lock, shift lock). The drive: a beige box, its two
+drives' fronts, each with its slot, its latch and its light. The monitor: its khaki steel case, the dark brown bezel
+round the tube, CUB, the red power switch.
+
+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `panel` (the keyboard panel from above, its keys' legends where their tops are),
+the screens (`boot`, `title`, `game_1`, `game_2`: Mode 7's boot and title, Mode 2's game), `bezel` (the monitor's
+front), `drive` (the drive's front), `floppy` (the floppy's top), and swatches. A region is (x, y, width, height) in
+pixels. """
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+U = 19.05                         # the keys' pitch
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 409.0, 358.0, 74.0
+FEET = 4.0                        # the case stands on them: 78 in all
+PANEL = dict(x=(-180.0, 180.0), y=(22.0, 182.0), depth=10.0)   # the keyboard panel, sunk into the lid
+STRIP = dict(y=(160.0, 182.0))    # the clear strip along the panel's back
+KEYS = dict(x=-142.0, y=148.0, height=12.0)   # the first row's left edge and middle (y); the keys' height off the floor
+# Each row: its offset from the left edge in keys, then (legend, width in keys, colour) for each key.
+ROWS = [
+    (2.25, [(f"f{k}", 1.0, "red") for k in range(10)] + [("BREAK", 1.0, "black")]),
+    (0.0, [("ESCAPE", 1.0, "black")] + [(c, 1.0, "black") for c in "1234567890=^\\"]
+     + [("←", 1.0, "brown"), ("→", 1.0, "brown")]),
+    (0.0, [("TAB", 1.5, "black")] + [(c, 1.0, "black") for c in "QWERTYUIOP@[£"]
+     + [("↑", 1.0, "brown"), ("↓", 1.0, "brown")]),
+    (0.0, [("CAPS LOCK", 1.0, "black"), ("CTRL", 1.25, "black")] + [(c, 1.0, "black") for c in "ASDFGHJKL;:]"]
+     + [("RETURN", 2.0, "black")]),
+    (0.0, [("SHIFT LOCK", 1.0, "black"), ("SHIFT", 1.75, "black")] + [(c, 1.0, "black") for c in "ZXCVBNM,./"]
+     + [("SHIFT", 1.75, "black"), ("DELETE", 1.0, "black"), ("COPY", 1.0, "brown")]),
+    (3.25, [(" ", 8.5, "black")]),
+]
+PLATE = dict(x=(-176.0, -148.0), y=(56.0, 98.0))     # the blank plate at the panel's left
+LIGHTS = dict(y=34.0, x=[-150.0, -122.0, -94.0])     # cassette motor, caps lock, shift lock
+
+DRIVE = dict(width=360.0, depth=250.0, height=80.0, y=186.0)   # the twin drive on the computer, just behind the
+                                                                # strip
+BAYS = dict(x=[-88.0, 88.0], size=(150.0, 42.0), z=40.0, slot=(112.0, 5.0), latch=(30.0, 7.0))   # z: above the
+                                                                # drive's foot
+MONITOR = dict(width=352.0, height=300.0, depth=415.0)        # on the drive, its front with the drive's
+SCREEN = dict(size=(272.0, 204.0), z=160.0, bulge=6.0)        # the tube's face, its middle's height above the monitor's
+                                                              # foot
+FLOPPY = dict(size=133.0, thickness=1.6, out=150.0, label=(110.0, 34.0))   # out: how far in front of its seat it
+                                                                # waits
+
+COLOURS = dict(case="#D6CDB6", monitor="#9E8E6C", bezel="#3A3029", print="#FFFFFF")

+"""The console theme's Amiga CD32 system model (godot/themes/console/models/systems/amigacd32.glb): the CD32 and its
+pad.
+
+Built in Blender from the real console's proportions (cd32_layout.py has the measurements, taken from photographs).
+The console is its side outline extruded across its width on a recessed base; the lid's seat, the CD's well under it
+and the vents' grooves are cut into its top. The lid is a slab on its own hinge, the round dome on it; RESET stands on
+the front face, the power light lit beside it. The pad is its traced outline lofted into a rounded slab, its D-pad,
+its four coloured buttons, the play/pause bar and its shoulder buttons on it. The printing is one texture drawn by
+cd32_print.py (the console from above, planar-mapped onto every face facing up; its front face; the pad's top; the
+CD's two sides; swatches).
+
+A node tree: a root (the turn to a three-quarter view, TILT_YAW and TILT_PITCH: the right end towards the viewer, the
+top tipped up; then the model spec's fit: standing on y = 0, centred, the largest side 1 m) holding the set; the set
+holding the lid (its origin on its hinge), the CD (waiting in its well, shrunk to nothing), the CD light (shrunk to
+nothing), and the pad's D-pad and its four buttons.
+
+The `focused` clip (8 s, looping) plays a CD: the lid swings up, the CD drops into the well and the lid shuts; the CD
+light flickers while it loads; the D-pad rocks and the red, blue, green and yellow buttons are pressed; then the lid
+swings up again, the CD lifts out and goes, and the lid shuts.
+
+Five materials (case, dark, pad, print, disc) and one texture, within the system model budget. Run from the repo root:
+
+    python tools/console-models/cd32_print.py artifacts/amigacd32
+    blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/console-models/cd32.py -- artifacts/amigacd32 godot/themes/console/models/systems/amigacd32.glb
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Matrix, Vector
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import cd32_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from amiga import paint, rounded, solid  # noqa: E402
+from clip import HIDDEN, Pose, back_out, ease_in, ease_out, key, phase, smooth, wobble  # noqa: E402
+from mega_drive_cartridge import bevel, boolean, box, export, join, material, prism_x, triangles  # noqa: E402
+
+TILT_YAW = -25.0     # degrees about the vertical: the right end comes towards the viewer
+TILT_PITCH = 30.0    # degrees about the horizontal: the top tips up towards the viewer
+ROUGHNESS = dict(case=0.55, dark=0.7, pad=0.55, print=0.5, disc=0.2)
+FRONT_H = L.FRONT[1][1]
+
+
+def atlas_uv(region, w, h):
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = region
+    return lambda a, b: ((rx + a / w * rw) / L.ATLAS, 1 - (ry + b / h * rh) / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+TOP = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["top"], L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH)
+FRONT = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["front"], L.WIDTH, FRONT_H)
+
+
+def top_uv(co):
+    return TOP(co.x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.DEPTH - co.y)
+
+
+def front_uv(co):
+    return FRONT(co.x + L.WIDTH / 2, FRONT_H - co.z)
+
+
+def swatch(name):
+    x, y = L.SWATCHES[name]
+    return lambda co: (x / L.ATLAS, 1 - y / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def painted(obj, m, name):
+    paint(obj, m["print"], swatch(name), lambda c, n, _name: True)
+    return obj
+
+
+def prism(name, outline, z0, z1, mat):
+    return solid(name, [[(x, y, z) for x, y in outline] for z in (z0, z1)], mat)
+
+
+def circle(cx, cy, r, n=24):
+    return [(cx + r * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / n), cy + r * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / n)) for k in range(n)]
+
+
+# ---- The console -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def console(m):
+    """The console: the body on its base, the lid's seat, the well and the vents cut; RESET and the power light; its top
+    and front printed."""
+    w, d = L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH
+    i = L.FOOT["inset"]
+    base = box("base", -w / 2 + i, w / 2 - i, i, d - i, 0.0, L.FOOT["height"] + 1.0, m["dark"])
+    body = prism_x("amigacd32", L.profile(), -w / 2, w / 2, m["case"])
+    bevel(body, 2.0, segments=2)
+    (x0, x1), (y0, y1), t = L.LID["x"], L.LID["y"], L.LID["thickness"]
+    boolean(body, box("seat", x0, x1, y0, y1 + 10.0, L.TOP_Z - t, L.TOP_Z + 10.0, m["case"]))

+    v = L.VENTS
+    boolean(body, join([box("vent", *v["x"], y - v["width"] / 2, y + v["width"] / 2, L.TOP_Z - v["depth"],
+                            L.TOP_Z + 5.0, m["dark"]) for y in v["y"]], "vents"))
+    paint(body, m["print"], top_uv, lambda c, n, name: n.z > 0.3 and name == "case")
+    paint(body, m["print"], front_uv, lambda c, n, name: n.y < -0.9 and name == "case")
+    spindle = prism("spindle", circle(wx, wy, 8.0, 20), L.TOP_Z - t - L.WELL["depth"], L.SPINDLE_Z, m["dark"])
+    (rx0, rx1), (rz0, rz1), out = L.RESET["x"], L.RESET["z"], L.RESET["out"]
+    reset = solid("reset", [[(x, y, z) for x, z in rounded((rx0 + rx1) / 2, (rz0 + rz1) / 2, rx1 - rx0, rz1 - rz0,
+                                                            (rz1 - rz0) / 2 - 0.2, 4)]
+                            for y in (1.0, -out)], m["case"])
+    bevel(reset, 0.8, segments=1)
+    px, pz = L.LIGHTS["power"]
+    lw, lh = L.LIGHTS["size"]
+    power = painted(box("power_light", px - lw / 2, px + lw / 2, -0.4, 0.5, pz - lh / 2, pz + lh / 2, m["print"]), m,
+                    "lit")
+    return [base, body, spindle, reset, power]
+
+
+def lid(m):
+    """The lid, its origin on its hinge along its back edge: the slab and its dome, its top printed."""
+    (x0, x1), (y0, y1), t = L.LID["x"], L.LID["y"], L.LID["thickness"]
+    slab = box("lid", x0 + 0.5, x1 - 0.5, y0 + 0.5, y1, L.TOP_Z - t + 0.4, L.TOP_Z, m["case"])
+    (dx, dy), r = L.DOME["at"], L.DOME["r"]
+    dome = solid("dome", [[(x, y, z) for x, y in circle(dx, dy, rr, 64)] for rr, z in
+                          ((r, L.TOP_Z - 1.0), (r, L.TOP_Z + L.DOME["rise"] - 1.5), (r - 2.0, L.TOP_Z + L.DOME["rise"]))],
+                 m["case"])
+    part = join([slab, dome], "lid")
+    bevel(part, 0.8, segments=2, angle=50)
+    paint(part, m["print"], top_uv, lambda c, n, name: n.z > 0.5)
+    hinge = Vector((0.0, y1, L.TOP_Z - t / 2))
+    part.data.transform(Matrix.Translation(-hinge))
+    return part, hinge
+
+
+def access_light(m):
+    x, z = L.LIGHTS["access"]
+    w, h = L.LIGHTS["size"]
+    part = painted(box("access", -w / 2, w / 2, -0.6, 0.4, -h / 2, h / 2, m["print"]), m, "amber")
+    return part, Vector((x, 0.0, z))
+
+
+def disc(m):
+    r, t = L.DISC["r"], L.DISC["thickness"]
+    part = prism("disc", circle(0.0, 0.0, r, 48), -t / 2, t / 2, m["disc"])
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["disc"], 2 * r, 2 * r)
+    bottom = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["data"], 2 * r, 2 * r)
+    paint(part, m["disc"], lambda co: top(co.x + r, r - co.y), lambda c, n, name: n.z > 0.9)
+    paint(part, m["disc"], lambda co: bottom(co.x + r, r + co.y), lambda c, n, name: n.z <= 0.9)
+    return part
+
+
+# ---- The pad ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def pad_frame():
+    """The pad's frame: its local (x, y), y from its front edge back; its middle at PAD["at"]."""
+    (px, py), turn = L.PAD["at"], L.PAD["turn"]
+    return (Matrix.Translation((px, py, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(turn), 4, "Z")
+            @ Matrix.Translation((0.0, -L.PAD["length"] / 2, 0.0)))
+
+
+def pad_outline():
+    points = list(L.PAD_OUTLINE)
+    area = sum(a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1] for a, b in zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]))
+    return points if area > 0 else list(reversed(points))
+
+
+def pad(m):
+    """The pad's body and its fixed parts (the play/pause bar, the shoulder buttons), at its place."""
+    p = L.PAD
+    t = p["thickness"]
+    body = prism("pad", pad_outline(), 0.0, t, m["pad"])
+    bevel(body, 6.0, segments=4, angle=30)
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["pad"], p["width"], p["length"])
+    paint(body, m["print"], lambda co: top(co.x + p["width"] / 2, p["length"] - co.y), lambda c, n, name: n.z > 0.8)
+    paint(body, m["print"], swatch("grey"), lambda c, n, name: n.z <= 0.8)
+    x, y, w, h = p["pause"]
+    bar = painted(prism("pause", rounded(x, y, w, h, h / 2 - 0.1, 3), t - 2.0, t + 1.2, m["print"]), m, "dark")
+    parts = [body, bar]
+    for side in (-1, 1):
+        shoulder = painted(box("shoulder", side * 56.0 - 13.0, side * 56.0 + 13.0, 76.0, 82.0, t - 10.0, t - 3.0,
+                               m["print"]), m, "dark")
+        bevel(shoulder, 1.5, segments=1)
+        parts.append(shoulder)
+    for part in parts:
+        part.data.transform(pad_frame())
+    return parts
+
+
+def pad_parts(m):
+    """The D-pad and the four buttons, each its middle at its origin, and where each goes."""
+    p = L.PAD
+    t = p["thickness"]
+    dx, dy, r = p["dpad"]
+    dpad = painted(prism("dpad", circle(0.0, 0.0, r, 32), -2.0, 2.4, m["print"]), m, "dark")
+    bumps = [painted(prism("bump", circle(r * 0.62 * math.cos(a), r * 0.62 * math.sin(a), 1.3, 10), 2.0, 3.2,
+                           m["print"]), m, "dark") for a in (0.0, math.pi / 2, math.pi, 3 * math.pi / 2)]
+    dpad = join([dpad] + bumps, "dpad")
+    parts = [("dpad", dpad, Vector((dx, dy, 0.0)))]
+    for name, (x, y, br) in p["buttons"].items():
+        button = painted(prism(name, circle(0.0, 0.0, br, 24), -2.0, 3.2, m["print"]), m, name)
+        bevel(button, 1.0, segments=2)
+        parts.append((name, button, Vector((x, y, 0.0))))
+    frame = pad_frame()
+    turn = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(L.PAD["turn"]), 4, "Z")
+    placed = []
+    for name, part, where in parts:
+        part.data.transform(turn)
+        at = frame @ where
+        placed.append((name, part, Vector((at.x, at.y, t))))
+    return placed
+
+
+# ---- The focused clip ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def appear(f, f0, f1):
+    return HIDDEN + (1 - HIDDEN) * back_out(phase(f, f0, f1)) if f >= f0 else HIDDEN
+
+
+def tap(f, f0, hold=2):
+    return smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 2)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f0 + 2 + hold, f0 + 5 + hold)))
+
+
+PRESSES = dict(red=(110, 130, 158), blue=(118, 142), green=(150, 166), yellow=(136, 172))
+ROCKS = [(96, 106, 0.0, 9.0), (122, 132, 9.0, 0.0), (150, 160, 0.0, -9.0)]
+
+
+def lid_angle(f):
+    open_ = L.LID["open"]
+    if f < 186:
+        return (open_ * back_out(phase(f, 8, 22), 1.3) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 48, 60)))
+                + wobble(f, 60, 2.0, period=8.0, decay=3.0))
+    return (open_ * back_out(phase(f, 186, 198), 1.3) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 214, 226)))
+            + wobble(f, 226, 2.0, period=8.0, decay=3.0))
+
+
+def timeline(f):
+    if f < 22 or f >= 212:
+        cd = Pose(scale=HIDDEN)
+    elif f < 30:
+        cd = Pose(z=60.0, scale=appear(f, 22, 28))
+    elif f < 42:
+        cd = Pose(z=60.0 * (1 - ease_in(phase(f, 30, 42))))
+    elif f < 198:
+        cd = Pose()
+    else:
+        cd = Pose(z=60.0 * ease_out(phase(f, 198, 206)), scale=max(HIDDEN, 1 - ease_in(phase(f, 204, 212))))
+    reading = 62 <= f < 98 and (f // 3) % 4 != 3
+    poses = {"lid": Pose(pitch=lid_angle(f)), "disc": cd, "access": Pose() if reading else Pose(scale=HIDDEN)}
+    for name, frames in PRESSES.items():
+        poses[name] = Pose(z=-2.0 * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in frames))
+    pitch = roll = 0.0
+    for f0, f1, pa, ro in ROCKS:
+        t = smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 3)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f1, f1 + 4)))
+        pitch, roll = pitch + pa * t, roll + ro * t
+    poses["dpad"] = Pose(pitch=pitch, roll=roll)
+    return poses
+
+
+# ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
+    images, out = os.path.abspath(args[0]), os.path.abspath(args[1])
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.render.fps = L.FPS
+    printed = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "cd32_print.png"))
+    colours = dict(L.COLOURS, print="#FFFFFF")
+    textures = dict(print=printed, disc=printed)
+    m = {n: material(n, colours[n], r, textures.get(n)) for n, r in ROUGHNESS.items()}
+
+    whole = join(console(m) + pad(m), "amigacd32")
+    cover, hinge = lid(m)
+    light, light_at = access_light(m)
+    cd = disc(m)
+    buttons = pad_parts(m)
+    for obj in [whole, cover] + [part for _, part, _ in buttons]:
+        for poly in obj.data.polygons:
+            poly.use_smooth = True
+        obj.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(40))
+
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("amigacd32_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    (wx, wy) = L.WELL["at"]
+    seat = Vector((wx, wy, L.SPINDLE_Z + L.DISC["thickness"] / 2))
+    placed = [(cover, hinge), (light, light_at), (cd, seat)] + [(part, where) for _, part, where in buttons]
+    for part, where in placed:
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+    nodes = {"lid": cover, "access": light, "disc": cd, **{name: part for name, part, _ in buttons}}
+
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole, cover, light, cd] + [part for _, part, _ in buttons]
+    print(f"CD32: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The Amiga CD32's measurements, shared by cd32_print.py (which draws its printing) and cd32.py (which builds it).
+Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+
+The Amiga CD32 (1993), 305 x 213 mm (the Computer History Museum's 12 x 8 3/8 inches), and its pad, 184 x 80 mm, lying
+in front of its left end. Millimetres: x from the console's middle (left to right), y back from its front, z up from
+the table. The rest was measured from Evan-Amos's photographs on Wikimedia Commons (the console from its front
+corners, with its lid open, with its pad, and the pad from above), scaled by the console's width; the pad's outline
+was traced from its photograph from above (its cable cut away).
+
+The console: a dark grey box on a recessed base, its front face (the control strip at the right: RESET, the two
+lights, the volume slider, the headphone socket) rising to a slope (the AMIGA CD32 badge at the right), then the flat
+top: at the left the lid over the CD well, hinged along its back, a round dome on it with 32bit printed and a smoked
+window in its front half; at the right the vents' grooves and Commodore.
+
+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `top` (the console seen from above: the lettering, the badge, the dome's
+printing; planar-mapped onto every face facing up), `front` (the front face), `pad` (the pad's top), `disc` and
+`data` (the CD's two sides: a made-up game, Odyssey), and swatches. A region is (x, y, width, height) in pixels.
+"""
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 305.0, 213.0, 66.0
+FOOT = dict(height=8.0, inset=6.0)                     # the recessed base under it
+FRONT = ((0.0, 8.0), (4.0, 40.0))                      # the front face: its foot and its top, (y, z)
+SLOPE = ((4.0, 40.0), (58.0, 62.0))                    # the slope up to the flat top
+TOP_Z = HEIGHT                                         # the flat top, from the slope's top to the back
+
+
+def profile():
+    """The side outline, (y, z), anticlockwise seen from the right end."""
+    (fy0, fz0), (fy1, fz1) = FRONT
+    (_, _), (sy1, sz1) = SLOPE
+    return [(fy0, fz0), (DEPTH, fz0), (DEPTH, TOP_Z - 3.0), (DEPTH - 3.0, TOP_Z), (sy1 + 6.0, TOP_Z), (sy1, sz1),
+            (fy1, fz1)]
+
+
+LID = dict(x=(-150.0, -4.0), y=(54.0, 209.0), thickness=6.0, open=-100.0)   # its plan; hinged along its back edge
+DOME = dict(at=(-77.0, 131.0), r=70.0, rise=5.0)       # the round dome on the lid
+WELL = dict(at=(-77.0, 131.0), r=62.0, depth=14.0)     # the CD's well under the lid
+VENTS = dict(x=(14.0, 140.0), y=[96.0 + 6.0 * k for k in range(16)], width=3.0, depth=2.0)
+RESET = dict(x=(30.0, 62.0), z=(18.0, 34.0), out=3.0)  # the RESET button, on the front face
+LIGHTS = dict(power=(84.0, 30.0), access=(84.0, 22.0), size=(14.0, 2.4))   # x, z on the front face
+
+DISC = dict(r=60.0, hole=7.5, thickness=1.2)
+SPINDLE_Z = TOP_Z - WELL["depth"] + 3.0                # where the CD sits in the well
+
+# The pad: its outline traced from above (y from its front edge, towards the player, back to the shoulder buttons;
+# the U's opening at the back), lying at PAD["at"], turned PAD["turn"] degrees.
+PAD_OUTLINE = [(0.0, 47.3), (38.7, 50.9), (39.7, 53.3), (34.5, 67.5), (34.5, 72.3), (36.4, 75.1), (40.7, 77.0),
+               (41.6, 79.4), (70.1, 79.4), (71.6, 76.5), (75.8, 75.1), (80.1, 71.3), (83.4, 64.2), (89.1, 44.7),
+               (92.0, 23.8), (89.6, 17.1), (85.8, 13.3), (75.4, 9.5), (39.7, 2.4), (2.1, 0.0), (-36.4, 1.9),
+               (-80.1, 10.9), (-85.8, 13.3), (-89.6, 17.1), (-92.0, 27.1), (-88.2, 49.4), (-82.0, 68.5),
+               (-76.8, 74.6), (-71.1, 76.5), (-70.1, 78.9), (-41.6, 78.9), (-37.8, 75.6), (-35.4, 72.7),
+               (-34.9, 68.0), (-39.7, 53.7), (-38.7, 50.9)]
+PAD = dict(at=(-110.0, -78.0), turn=8.0, thickness=26.0, length=80.4, width=184.0,
+           dpad=(-65.4, 47.9, 13.4), buttons=dict(green=(53.6, 53.3, 5.9), yellow=(70.9, 58.8, 5.9),
+                                                  red=(58.5, 36.0, 7.1), blue=(75.4, 40.9, 5.9)),
+           pause=(22.8, 22.6, 23.8, 5.0), logo=(-19.8, 32.0, 46.0), band=26.0)
+
+COLOURS = dict(case="#3A3B3E", dark="#141416", pad="#4A4B4F", disc="#FFFFFF")
+
+REGIONS = dict(top=(0, 0, 1024, 715), front=(0, 723, 1024, 120), pad=(0, 851, 400, 173), disc=(408, 851, 172, 172),
+               data=(588, 851, 172, 172))
+SWATCHES = dict(dark=(784, 872), green=(816, 872), yellow=(848, 872), red=(880, 872), blue=(912, 872),
+                lit=(944, 872), amber=(976, 872), grey=(784, 904), smoke=(816, 904))
+
+FPS = 30
+LENGTH = 240                 # 8 s

+"""The Amiga CD32's printing, for the console theme's CD32 model (tools/console-models/cd32.py).
+
+Draws its atlas, its regions as cd32_layout.py places them, each in millimetres as the model's planar UVs map it: the
+console seen from above (32bit on the dome, its smoked window, Commodore, the AMIGA CD32 badge on the slope); its front
+face (RESET, the power and CD lights off, the volume slider's slot and scale, the headphone socket); the pad's top
+(its D-pad's ring and dots, AMIGA CD32, the play/pause slot and its marks, the buttons' marks); the CD's two sides (a
+made-up game, Odyssey, and the shiny side); and the swatches small parts take their colour from. Run it with the
+system Python (Pillow):
+
+    python tools/console-models/cd32_print.py <out folder>
+
+It writes cd32_print.png there.
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import cd32_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from psp_print import ship, space  # noqa: E402
+from retro_pc_print import rgb, shade  # noqa: E402
+from windows_pc_print import FONTS, Region  # noqa: E402
+
+CASE = rgb(L.COLOURS["case"])
+PAD = rgb(L.COLOURS["pad"])
+RED = (214, 64, 44)
+WHITE = (232, 232, 232)
+
+
+def amiga_cd32(reg, x, y, size):
+    """AMIGA in red serif italics, CD in white, 32 in small red: its left edge at x, its middle at y."""
+    f1 = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "timesbi.ttf", max(1, round(size * reg.sx)))
+    f2 = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "ariblk.ttf", max(1, round(size * 0.92 * reg.sx)))
+    f3 = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "ariblk.ttf", max(1, round(size * 0.48 * reg.sx)))
+    px, py = reg.p(x, y)
+    reg.draw.text((px, py), "AMIGA", font=f1, fill=RED, anchor="lm")
+    px += f1.getlength("AMIGA") + size * 0.4 * reg.sx
+    reg.draw.text((px, py), "CD", font=f2, fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
+    px += f2.getlength("CD") + size * 0.06 * reg.sx
+    reg.draw.text((px, py - size * 0.24 * reg.sy), "32", font=f3, fill=RED, anchor="lm")
+
+
+def top():
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["top"], L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH, CASE)
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.DEPTH - y
+    (dx, dy), r = L.DOME["at"], L.DOME["r"]
+    reg.circle(*at(dx, dy), r, shade(CASE, 0.06))
+    reg.circle(*at(dx, dy), r, None, outline=shade(CASE, -0.3), width=0.5)
+    layer = reg.layer()                                      # the smoked window: the dome's front half, lens-shaped
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    d.chord(reg.box(*at(dx - r * 0.82, dy + r * 0.25), *at(dx + r * 0.82, dy - r * 0.95)), 0, 180,
+            fill=(14, 14, 16, 255))
+    reg.over(layer)
+    reg.line([at(dx - r * 0.92, dy + r * 0.36), at(dx + r * 0.92, dy + r * 0.36)], shade(CASE, -0.3), 0.5)
+    layer = reg.layer()
+    f = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "ariblk.ttf", max(1, round(13.0 * reg.sx)))
+    ImageDraw.Draw(layer).text(reg.p(*at(dx - 4.0, dy + r * 0.62)), "32bit", font=f, fill=(206, 206, 210, 255),
+                               anchor="mm")
+    reg.over(layer.transform(layer.size, Image.AFFINE, (1, 0.15, -0.15 * reg.p(0, at(0, dy + r * 0.62)[1])[1],
+                                                        0, 1, 0)))
+    reg.text("Commodore", "arialbd.ttf", 9.0, *at(98.0, 190.0), WHITE)
+    reg.rect_(*at(16.0, 52.0), *at(142.0, 30.0), (24, 24, 26))
+    amiga_cd32(reg, *at(22.0, 41.0), 11.0)
+    reg.text("DO NOT STARE INTO BEAM", "arial.ttf", 2.6, *at(-104.0, 32.0), shade(CASE, -0.25))
+    return reg
+
+
+FRONT_H = L.FRONT[1][1]
+
+
+def front():
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["front"], L.WIDTH, FRONT_H, CASE)
+
+    def at(x, z):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, FRONT_H - z
+    (x0, x1), (z0, z1) = L.RESET["x"], L.RESET["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(x0 - 2.0, z1 + 2.0), *at(x1 + 2.0, z0 - 2.0), shade(CASE, -0.2), r=(z1 - z0) / 2 + 2.0)
+    reg.text("RESET", "arial.ttf", 2.4, *at((x0 + x1) / 2, z0 - 5.0), shade(CASE, 0.35))
+    w, h = L.LIGHTS["size"]
+    for name, colour in (("power", (60, 30, 26)), ("access", (60, 46, 20))):
+        x, z = L.LIGHTS[name]
+        reg.rect_(*at(x - w / 2, z + h / 2), *at(x + w / 2, z - h / 2), colour, r=0.6)
+    reg.rect_(*at(104.0, 28.0), *at(130.0, 24.0), (12, 12, 13))
+    for k in range(14):
+        reg.rect_(*at(104.0 + 2.0 * k, 19.0), *at(104.6 + 2.0 * k, 17.0 - k * 0.12), shade(CASE, 0.25))
+    reg.circle(*at(140.0, 26.0), 2.6, (10, 10, 11))
+    reg.circle(*at(140.0, 26.0), 1.2, (60, 60, 64))
+    return reg
+
+
+def pad():
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["pad"], L.PAD["width"], L.PAD["length"], PAD)
+    p = L.PAD
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + L.PAD["width"] / 2, L.PAD["length"] - y
+    reg.line([at(-48.0, p["band"]), at(48.0, p["band"])], shade(PAD, -0.4), 0.8)
+    dx, dy, r = p["dpad"]
+    reg.circle(*at(dx, dy), r + 1.2, shade(PAD, -0.35))
+    for k, glyph in enumerate(("▲", "▶", "▼", "◀")):
+        a = math.pi / 2 - k * math.pi / 2
+        reg.text(glyph, "seguisym.ttf", 2.2, *at(dx + (r + 4.0) * math.cos(a), dy + (r + 4.0) * math.sin(a)),
+                 shade(PAD, -0.4))
+    for name, (x, y, br) in p["buttons"].items():
+        reg.circle(*at(x, y), br + 1.0, shade(PAD, -0.3))
+    reg.line([at(53.6, 53.3), at(70.9, 58.8)], shade(PAD, -0.3), 7.0)
+    reg.line([at(58.5, 36.0), at(75.4, 40.9)], shade(PAD, -0.3), 7.0)
+    lx, ly, lw = p["logo"]
+    amiga_cd32(reg, *at(lx - lw / 2, ly), 6.4)
+    x, y, w, h = p["pause"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(x - w / 2, y + h / 2), *at(x + w / 2, y - h / 2), (16, 16, 18), r=h / 2)
+    reg.text("II ▶", "seguisym.ttf", 2.6, *at(x + 4.0, y - 6.0), shade(PAD, -0.4))
+    reg.text("◀◀", "seguisym.ttf", 2.6, *at(-62.0, 72.0), shade(PAD, -0.4))
+    reg.text("▶▶", "seguisym.ttf", 2.6, *at(62.0, 72.0), shade(PAD, -0.4))
+    return reg
+
+
+def disc_side(region, label):
+    r = L.DISC["r"]
+    reg = Region(region, 2 * r, 2 * r, (40, 40, 44))
+    c = r
+    if label:
+        art = space((560, 560))
+        d = ImageDraw.Draw(art)
+        ship(d, 200, 240, 3.6, "#FFFFFF", "#FFB23C")
+        x0, y0, x1, y1 = reg.box(0.0, 0.0, 2 * r, 2 * r)
+        reg.img.paste(art.convert("RGB").resize((round(x1 - x0), round(y1 - y0)), Image.LANCZOS), (0, 0))
+        reg.text("ODYSSEY", "ariblk.ttf", 15.0, c, c - 34.0, (255, 214, 70))
+        reg.rect_(0.0, c + 20.0, 2 * r, 2 * r, (20, 20, 22))
+        amiga_cd32(reg, c - 32.0, c + 32.0, 10.0)
+    else:
