+"""The console theme's Philips CD-i system model (godot/themes/console/models/systems/cdimono1.glb): a CD-i 220 and its
+gamepad.
+
+Built in Blender from the real player's proportions (cdi_layout.py has the measurements, taken from photographs). The
+body is a box on four feet, the tray's opening cut into its front and the vents into its top; the buttons stand proud
+of the front, the display's smoked window over its place. The tray is its door and, behind it, the black platform the
+disc lies in. The gamepad is its arched outline extruded, a raised plate on it, the ring round the thumbpad and the
+buttons' slanted well cut into the plate, the thumbpad and the three buttons standing in them. The printing is one
+texture drawn by cdi_print.py: the front (planar-mapped onto the faces facing forward: the door's dots and logo,
+PHILIPS, the buttons' names), the window three ways (dark, the disc read, playing), the disc's label, the gamepad's top,
+and swatches.
+
+A node tree: a root (the turn to a three-quarter view, TILT_YAW and TILT_PITCH: the right side towards the viewer, the
+top tipped up; then the model spec's fit: standing on y = 0, centred, the largest side 1 m) holding the set; the set
+holding the tray (and on it the disc, shrunk to nothing), OPEN, the two lit windows (shrunk to nothing) and the gamepad;
+the gamepad holding its thumbpad and its three buttons.
+
+The `focused` clip (8 s, looping) plays a disc: OPEN is pressed and the tray slides out; the disc drops onto it and the
+tray goes in; the display reads the disc (CD-i), then plays, the gamepad's thumbpad and buttons played. Then OPEN again,
+the tray comes out, the disc lifts away and the tray goes back in.
+
+Five materials (case, button, black, glass, print) and one texture, within the system model budget. Run from the repo
+root:
+
+    python tools/console-models/cdi_print.py artifacts/cdi
+    blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/console-models/cdi.py -- artifacts/cdi godot/themes/console/models/systems/cdimono1.glb
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import bmesh
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Matrix, Vector
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import cdi_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from amiga import curved, paint, rounded, solid  # noqa: E402
+from clip import HIDDEN, Pose, back_out, ease_in, ease_out, key, phase, smooth, wobble  # noqa: E402
+from mega_drive_cartridge import bevel, boolean, box, export, join, material, new_object, triangles  # noqa: E402
+from msx_layout import inset  # noqa: E402
+
+TILT_YAW = -22.0     # degrees about the vertical: the right side comes towards the viewer
+TILT_PITCH = 25.0    # degrees about the horizontal: the top tips up towards the viewer
+ROUGHNESS = dict(case=0.55, button=0.5, black=0.6, glass=0.12, print=0.5)
+DOOR_FRONT = 1.0     # the door's face, back from the front's
+
+
+# ---- UVs -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def atlas_uv(region, w, h):
+    """A face drawn w x h into region: (a, b) millimetres across it (a to the right, b down from its top) to UVs."""
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = region
+    return lambda a, b: ((rx + a / w * rw) / L.ATLAS, 1 - (ry + b / h * rh) / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+FRONT = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["front"], L.WIDTH, L.HEIGHT - L.FOOT)
+
+
+def front_uv(co):
+    """The front seen from in front."""
+    return FRONT(co.x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.HEIGHT - co.z)
+
+
+def swatch(name):
+    x, y = L.SWATCHES[name]
+    return lambda co: (x / L.ATLAS, 1 - y / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def facing_front(c, n, name):
+    return n.y < -0.9
+
+
+# ---- The player ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def body(m):
+    """The body on its feet: the tray's opening cut into its front, the vents into its top, its front printed."""
+    w = L.WIDTH
+    shell = box("cdi", -w / 2, w / 2, 0.0, L.DEPTH, L.FOOT, L.HEIGHT, m["case"])
+    bevel(shell, 2.0, segments=2)
+    (dx0, dx1), (dz0, dz1) = L.DOOR["x"], L.DOOR["z"]
+    boolean(shell, box("opening", dx0, dx1, -5.0, 150.0, dz0, dz1, m["black"]))
+    v = L.VENTS
+    step = (v["y"][1] - v["y"][0]) / v["count"]
+    for x0, x1 in v["columns"]:
+        boolean(shell, join([box("vent", x0, x1, v["y"][0] + (k + 0.5) * step - v["width"] / 2,
+                                 v["y"][0] + (k + 0.5) * step + v["width"] / 2, L.HEIGHT - v["depth"], L.HEIGHT + 5.0,
+                                 m["black"]) for k in range(v["count"])], "vents"))
+    paint(shell, m["print"], front_uv, lambda c, n, name: n.y < -0.9 and c.y < 0.5 and name == "case")
+    (fx0, fx1, fx2, fx3), ys = L.FEET["x"], L.FEET["y"]
+    feet = [box("foot", a, b, y0, y1, 0.0, L.FOOT + 1.0, m["black"]) for a, b in ((fx0, fx1), (fx2, fx3))
+            for y0, y1 in ys]
+    return [shell] + feet
+
+
+def button(name, x0, x1, z0, z1, m):
+    part = box(name, x0, x1, -L.BUTTON_OUT, 1.0, z0, z1, m["button"])
+    bevel(part, 0.9, segments=2)
+    return part
+
+
+def window(m):
+    (x0, x1), (z0, z1) = L.WINDOW["x"], L.WINDOW["z"]
+    part = box("window", x0, x1, -L.WINDOW["out"], 1.0, z0, z1, m["glass"])
+    bevel(part, 0.6, segments=1)
+    face = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["display"], x1 - x0, z1 - z0)
+    paint(part, m["glass"], lambda co: face(co.x - x0, z1 - co.z), facing_front)
+    return part
+
+
+def lit_window(m, name):
+    """A lit window over the dark one, its middle at its origin."""
+    (x0, x1), (z0, z1) = L.WINDOW["x"], L.WINDOW["z"]
+    w, h = x1 - x0, z1 - z0
+    face = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS[name], w, h)
+    part = curved(name, w - 0.6, h - 0.6, 0.0, lambda a, b: face(0.3 + a * (w - 0.6), 0.3 + b * (h - 0.6)), m["glass"],
+                  nu=1, nv=1)
+    return part, Vector(((x0 + x1) / 2, -L.WINDOW["out"] - 0.15, (z0 + z1) / 2))
+
+
+def tray(m):
+    """The tray, at rest in the body: its door, the platform behind it with the disc's recess."""
+    (dx0, dx1), (dz0, dz1) = L.DOOR["x"], L.DOOR["z"]
+    g = 0.6
+    door = box("tray", dx0 + g, dx1 - g, DOOR_FRONT, DOOR_FRONT + 3.0, dz0 + g, dz1 - g, m["case"])
+    bevel(door, 0.6, segments=1)
+    paint(door, m["print"], front_uv, lambda c, n, name: n.y < -0.9)
+    p = L.PLATFORM
+    platform = box("platform", *p["x"], DOOR_FRONT + 3.0, DOOR_FRONT + 3.0 + p["depth"], p["top"] - p["thickness"],
+                   p["top"], m["black"])
+    rx, ry = L.RECESS["centre"]
+    r = L.RECESS["diameter"] / 2
+    boolean(platform, solid("recess", [[(rx + r * math.cos(a), DOOR_FRONT + ry + r * math.sin(a), z)
+                                        for a in (2 * math.pi * k / 48 for k in range(48))]
+                                       for z in (p["top"] - L.RECESS["depth"], p["top"] + 5.0)], m["black"]))
+    return join([door, platform], "tray")
+
+
+def disc(m):
+    """The disc, its middle at its origin, lying flat: a ring, its label on its top."""
+    ro, ri, t = L.DISC["diameter"] / 2, L.DISC["hole"] / 2, L.DISC["thickness"]
+    n = 64
+    bm = bmesh.new()
+    rings = [[bm.verts.new((r * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / n), r * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / n), z)) for k in range(n)]
+             for r, z in ((ro, -t / 2), (ro, t / 2), (ri, t / 2), (ri, -t / 2))]
+    for a, b in zip(rings, rings[1:] + rings[:1]):
+        for k in range(n):
+            j = (k + 1) % n
+            bm.faces.new([a[k], a[j], b[j], b[k]])
+    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
+    part = new_object("disc", bm, m["print"])
+    d = L.DISC["diameter"]
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["disc_top"], d, d)
+    paint(part, m["print"], lambda co: top(co.x + d / 2, d / 2 - co.y), lambda c, n_, name: n_.z > 0.9)
+    paint(part, m["print"], swatch("silver"), lambda c, n_, name: n_.z <= 0.9)
+    return part
+
+
+# ---- The gamepad -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def pad(m):
+    """The gamepad in its own frame (its plan's origin, the table): its base, the plate on it with the thumbpad's ring
+    and the buttons' well cut into it; the thumbpad and the buttons apart (the clip plays them), each its foot's middle
+    at its origin."""
+    P = L.PAD
+    outline = L.PAD_OUTLINE
+    base = solid("pad", [[(x, y, z) for x, y in outline] for z in (0.0, P["base"])], m["case"])
+    bevel(base, 3.0, segments=2)
+    i, top = P["plate"]
+    plate = solid("plate", [[(x, y, z) for x, y in inset(outline, i)] for z in (P["base"] - 1.0, top)], m["case"])
+    bevel(plate, 2.0, segments=2)
+    d = P["dpad"]
+    cx, cy = d["at"]
+    floor = top - 2.5
+    boolean(plate, solid("ring", [[(cx + d["ring"] * math.cos(a), cy + d["ring"] * math.sin(a), z)
+                                   for a in (2 * math.pi * k / 40 for k in range(40))] for z in (floor, top + 5.0)],
+                         m["button"]))
+    b = P["buttons"]
+    (ax, ay), (bx, by) = b["at"][0], b["at"][-1]
+    turn = math.atan2(by - ay, bx - ax)
+    r = b["r"] + b["margin"]
+    well = rounded(0.0, 0.0, math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay) + 2 * r, 2 * r, r - 0.01, 6)
+    mx, my = (ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2
+    c, s = math.cos(turn), math.sin(turn)
+    boolean(plate, solid("well", [[(mx + x * c - y * s, my + x * s + y * c, z) for x, y in well]
+                                  for z in (top - 2.0, top + 5.0)], m["button"]))
+    xs = [x for x, _ in L.PAD_OUTLINE]
+    w = max(xs) - min(xs)
+    face = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["pad"], w, 101.0)
+    paint(plate, m["print"], lambda co: face(co.x + w / 2, 101.0 - co.y), lambda c_, n, name: n.z > 0.9 and
+          name == "case")
+    shell = join([base, plate], "pad")
+
+    thumb = solid("dpad", [[(d["disc"] * math.cos(a), d["disc"] * math.sin(a), z)
+                            for a in (2 * math.pi * k / 32 for k in range(32))] for z in (-1.0, d["height"])],
+                  m["button"])
+    bevel(thumb, 1.2, segments=2)
+    cross = join([box("arm", -12.0, 12.0, -4.2, 4.2, d["height"] - 0.5, d["height"] + 1.6, m["button"]),
+                  box("arm", -4.2, 4.2, -12.0, 12.0, d["height"] - 0.5, d["height"] + 1.6, m["button"])], "cross")
+    thumb = join([thumb, cross], "dpad")
+    buttons = []
+    for k, (x, y) in enumerate(b["at"]):
+        part = solid(f"button_{k + 1}", [[(b["r"] * math.cos(a), b["r"] * math.sin(a), z)
+                                          for a in (2 * math.pi * j / 28 for j in range(28))]
+                                         for z in (-1.0, b["height"])], m["button"])
+        bevel(part, 1.4, segments=2)
+        buttons.append((part, Vector((x, y, top - 2.0))))
+    return shell, (thumb, Vector((cx, cy, floor))), buttons
+
+
+# ---- The focused clip ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def appear(f, f0, f1):
+    return HIDDEN + (1 - HIDDEN) * back_out(phase(f, f0, f1)) if f >= f0 else HIDDEN
+
+
+def tap(f, f0, hold=2):
+    """A press at f0: down in three frames, held, back up in four."""
+    return smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 3)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f0 + 3 + hold, f0 + 7 + hold)))
+
+
+TILTS = [(112, "right"), (126, "up"), (140, "left"), (154, "down"), (176, "right")]
+PRESSES = {"button_1": (118, 166), "button_2": (132, 186), "button_3": (150,)}
+
+
+def tray_out(f):
+    if f < 54:
+        return back_out(phase(f, 12, 26), 1.2)
+    if f < 196:
+        return 1 - smooth(phase(f, 54, 70))
+    if f < 220:
+        return back_out(phase(f, 196, 210), 1.2)
+    return 1 - smooth(phase(f, 222, 238))
+
+
+def timeline(f):
+    if f < 26 or f >= 222:
+        dsk = Pose(scale=HIDDEN)
+    elif f < 36:
+        dsk = Pose(z=70.0, scale=appear(f, 26, 34))
+    elif f < 48:
+        dsk = Pose(z=70.0 * (1 - ease_in(phase(f, 36, 48))))
+    elif f < 210:
+        dsk = Pose(z=wobble(f, 48, 1.2, period=6.0, decay=5.0))
+    else:
+        dsk = Pose(z=60.0 * ease_out(phase(f, 210, 218)), scale=max(HIDDEN, 1 - ease_in(phase(f, 214, 222))))
+    tilt = dict(right=(0.0, 1.0), left=(0.0, -1.0), up=(-1.0, 0.0), down=(1.0, 0.0))
+    pitch = roll = 0.0
+    for f0, way in TILTS:
+        k = tap(f, f0, hold=4)
+        pitch += 8.0 * tilt[way][0] * k
+        roll += 8.0 * tilt[way][1] * k
+    poses = {"tray": Pose(y=-L.TRAY_OUT * tray_out(f)), "disc": dsk,
+             "open": Pose(y=1.5 * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in (8, 50, 192))),
+             "display_disc": Pose() if 72 <= f < 108 and (f < 80 or f % 8 < 6) else Pose(scale=HIDDEN),
+             "display_play": Pose() if 108 <= f < 194 else Pose(scale=HIDDEN),
+             "dpad": Pose(pitch=pitch, roll=roll)}
+    for name, frames in PRESSES.items():
+        poses[name] = Pose(z=-2.4 * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in frames))
+    return poses
+
+
+# ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
+    images, out = os.path.abspath(args[0]), os.path.abspath(args[1])
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.render.fps = L.FPS
+    printed = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "cdi_print.png"))
+    colours = dict(L.COLOURS, print="#FFFFFF")
+    m = {n: material(n, colours[n], r, printed if n in ("print", "glass") else None) for n, r in ROUGHNESS.items()}
+
+    buttons = {name: button(name, x0, x1, z0, z1, m) for name, x0, x1, z0, z1 in L.BUTTONS}
+    opener = buttons.pop("open")
+    whole = join(body(m) + list(buttons.values()) + [window(m)], "cdimono1")
+    drawer = tray(m)
+    platter = disc(m)
+    lit = {name: lit_window(m, name) for name in ("display_disc", "display_play")}
+    shell, (thumb, thumb_at), presses = pad(m)
+    for obj in [whole, opener, drawer, platter, shell, thumb] + [part for part, _ in presses]:
+        for p in obj.data.polygons:
+            p.use_smooth = True
+        obj.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+
+    # The node tree: the root (the view and the fit) holds the set; the set holds the moving parts at their places.
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("cdimono1_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    rx, ry = L.RECESS["centre"]
+    seat = Vector((rx, DOOR_FRONT + ry, L.PLATFORM["top"] - L.RECESS["depth"] + L.DISC["thickness"] / 2 + 0.1))
+    for part in (drawer, opener):
+        part.parent = whole
+    platter.parent = drawer
+    platter.location = seat
+    for name, (part, where) in lit.items():
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+    (px, py), turn = L.PAD["at"], math.radians(L.PAD["turn"])
+    shell.parent = whole
+    shell.location = (px, py, 0.0)
+    shell.rotation_euler = (0.0, 0.0, turn)
+    thumb.parent = shell
+    thumb.location = thumb_at
+    for part, where in presses:
+        part.parent = shell
+        part.location = where
+    nodes = {"tray": drawer, "disc": platter, "open": opener, "dpad": thumb, **{n: p for n, (p, _) in lit.items()},
+             **{part.name: part for part, _ in presses}}
+
+    # The three-quarter view, then the spec's fit of the set at rest, as the root's transform.
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    rest = Matrix.Translation((px, py, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(turn, 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices] + [tilt @ rest @ v.co for v in shell.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole, opener, drawer, platter, shell, thumb] + [p for p, _ in lit.values()] + [p for p, _ in presses]
+    print(f"CD-i: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The Philips CD-i 220's measurements, shared by cdi_print.py (which draws its printing and its display) and cdi.py
+(which builds it). Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+
+The CD-i 220, one of Philips's consumer 200 series of CD-i players, a grey hi-fi box: 420 x 286 x 90 mm (HiFi Engine's
+figures, its feet included), and its gamepad in front of it. Millimetres: x from its middle (left to right), y back from
+its front face, z up from the table. The rest was measured from photographs on Wikimedia Commons (Evan-Amos's views of
+it from the front left and right and with its gamepad, a view of it from in front, the gamepad from above), scaled by
+its width.
+
+The body: a box on four feet, the vents in its top at the back right. Its front, left to right: the disc tray's door
+(the dots and the Compact Disc Interactive logo on it, PHILIPS on the strip under it), the panel with PREVIOUS, PLAY,
+NEXT and OPEN, the display's smoked window (it pulls down: the gamepad's socket is behind it), and the panel with
+ON/OFF, PAUSE and STOP. The tray: its door, and behind it the platform the disc lies in, sliding out of the body's
+opening. The gamepad (in front of the display, clear of the tray's way): the CD-i's own, its outline (PAD_OUTLINE) a
+wide arch, a raised plate on it, the thumbpad in its ring at the left, three buttons in a slanted recess at the right.
+
+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `front` (the front seen from in front: the door's dots and logo, PHILIPS, the
+buttons' names, the lines between the panels), `display` (the window: smoked red, the display's segments unlit, the
+model's name and PULL TO OPEN), `display_disc` and `display_play` (the window lit: the disc read, CD-i's logo; and
+playing, the track and its time), `disc_top` (the disc's label: a made-up game, Odyssey), `pad` (the gamepad's top:
+CD-i, the thumbpad's marks, the buttons' dots, SPEED), and swatches. A region is (x, y, width, height) in pixels.
+"""
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 420.0, 286.0, 88.0
+FOOT = 8.0                                                  # the feet's height: the body stands on them
+FEET = dict(x=(-196.0, -166.0, 166.0, 196.0), y=((14.0, 34.0), (252.0, 272.0)))   # each foot's x0, x1; y0, y1
+
+# The front, (x, z): the tray's door, the panels, the display's window; the strip along the top.
+DOOR = dict(x=(-206.4, -28.7), z=(25.6, 78.0), inset=1.5)
+OPENING = dict(x=(-204.0, -31.0), z=(27.0, 76.0), depth=150.0)     # the body's opening behind the door
+MIDDLE = dict(x=(-27.0, 20.0))
+WINDOW = dict(x=(21.5, 165.0), z=(24.0, 74.0), out=1.0)

+"""The Philips CD-i 220's printing and display, for the console theme's CD-i model (tools/console-models/cdi.py).
+
+Draws its atlas, its regions as cdi_layout.py places them, each in millimetres as the model's planar UVs map it: the
+front seen from in front (the door's dots and the Compact Disc Interactive logo, PHILIPS on the strip under it, the
+buttons' names, the lines between the panels); the display's window three ways (smoked red, its segments unlit, CDI
+220 CD-INTERACTIVE PLAYER and PULL TO OPEN; lit, the disc read: CD-i in its digits; lit, playing: PLAY, the track and
+its time); the disc's label (a made-up game, Odyssey); the gamepad's top (CD-i, the thumbpad's marks, the buttons'
+dots, SPEED); and the swatches small parts take their colour from. Run it with the system Python (Pillow):
+
+    python tools/console-models/cdi_print.py <out folder>
+
+It writes cdi_print.png there.
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import cdi_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from psp_print import ship, space  # noqa: E402
+from retro_pc_print import rgb, shade  # noqa: E402
+from windows_pc_print import Region  # noqa: E402
+
+CASE = rgb(L.COLOURS["case"])
+LABEL = (196, 198, 200)
+SMOKE = (44, 16, 18)
+VFD = (150, 244, 228)
+UNLIT = (60, 26, 28)
+
+
+# ---- The front ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def disc_logo(reg, x, y, h, ink):
+    """The Compact Disc Interactive logo, h tall, its top left at (x, y): COMPACT over disc, Interactive in a box."""
+    reg.text("COMPACT", "arial.ttf", h * 0.16, x + h * 0.62, y + h * 0.1, ink)
+    reg.text("disc", "arialbd.ttf", h * 0.62, x + h * 0.62, y + h * 0.48, ink)
+    reg.rect_(x + h * 0.05, y + h * 0.78, x + h * 1.2, y + h * 1.02, None, outline=ink, width=0.25)
+    reg.text("Interactive", "arial.ttf", h * 0.17, x + h * 0.62, y + h * 0.9, ink)
+
+
+def front():
+    w, h = L.WIDTH, L.HEIGHT - L.FOOT
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["front"], w, h, CASE)
+
+    def at(x, z):
+        return x + w / 2, L.HEIGHT - z
+    line = shade(CASE, -0.3)
+    (ax, ay), (bx, _) = at(-w / 2, L.TOP_STRIP), at(w / 2, L.TOP_STRIP)
+    reg.line([(ax, ay), (bx, ay)], line, 0.5)
+    reg.line([(ax, ay + 0.5), (bx, ay + 0.5)], shade(CASE, 0.1), 0.3)
+    for x in (L.MIDDLE["x"][1] + 0.75, L.RIGHT_PANEL["x"][0] - 1.0):            # the lines between the panels
+        reg.line([at(x, L.FOOT), at(x, L.TOP_STRIP)], line, 0.5)
+    (dx0, dx1), (dz0, dz1) = L.DOOR["x"], L.DOOR["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(dx0 - 0.8, dz1 + 0.8), *at(dx1 + 0.8, dz0 - 0.8), shade(CASE, -0.4))   # the door's gap
+    reg.rect_(*at(dx0, dz1), *at(dx1, dz0), shade(CASE, -0.03))
+    for k in range(7):                                      # the door's dots
+        reg.circle(*at(dx0 + 8.0 + 2.6 * k, dz1 - 9.0), 0.35, shade(CASE, 0.22))
+    disc_logo(reg, *at(dx0 + 7.0, dz0 + 14.0), 10.0, shade(CASE, 0.22))
+    reg.text("PHILIPS", "arialbd.ttf", 5.4, *at(dx0 + 22.0, (L.FOOT + dz0) / 2), (214, 214, 216))
+    for name, x0, x1, z0, z1 in L.BUTTONS:                  # the buttons' names over them
+        reg.rect_(*at(x0 - 0.7, z1 + 0.7), *at(x1 + 0.7, z0 - 0.7), shade(CASE, -0.35), r=1.2)
+        label = {"previous": "PREVIOUS", "play": "PLAY", "next": "NEXT", "open": "OPEN", "onoff": "ON / OFF",
+                 "pause": "PAUSE", "stop": "STOP"}[name]
+        reg.text(label, "arial.ttf", 1.9, *at((x0 + x1) / 2, z1 + 2.4), LABEL)
+    (wx0, wx1), (wz0, wz1) = L.WINDOW["x"], L.WINDOW["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(wx0 - 0.6, wz1 + 0.6), *at(wx1 + 0.6, wz0 - 0.6), shade(CASE, -0.4))
+    return reg
+
+
+# ---- The display -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+SEGMENTS = {"0": "abcdef", "1": "bc", "2": "abged", "3": "abgcd", "4": "fgbc", "5": "afgcd", "6": "afgedc", "7": "abc",
+            "8": "abcdefg", "9": "abcdfg", "-": "g", "C": "afed", "d": "bcdeg", "i": "e", " ": ""}
+
+
+def digit(reg, ch, x, y, w, h, colour):
+    """A seven-segment digit, w x h, its top left at (x, y)."""
+    t = w * 0.16
+    segs = {"a": (x + t, y, x + w - t, y + t), "g": (x + t, y + h / 2 - t / 2, x + w - t, y + h / 2 + t / 2),
+            "d": (x + t, y + h - t, x + w - t, y + h), "f": (x, y + t, x + t, y + h / 2 - t / 2),
+            "b": (x + w - t, y + t, x + w, y + h / 2 - t / 2), "e": (x, y + h / 2 + t / 2, x + t, y + h - t),
+            "c": (x + w - t, y + h / 2 + t / 2, x + w, y + h - t)}
+    for s in SEGMENTS[ch]:
+        x0, y0, x1, y1 = segs[s]
+        reg.rect_(x0, y0, x1, y1, colour, r=t * 0.3)
+    if ch == "i":
+        reg.rect_(x, y + h / 2 - t * 1.6, x + t, y + h / 2 - t * 0.6, colour)
+
+
+def display(name):
+    """The window: smoked red, the segments faint behind it; lit as the disc is read, or playing."""
+    w, h = L.WINDOW["x"][1] - L.WINDOW["x"][0], L.WINDOW["z"][1] - L.WINDOW["z"][0]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS[name], w, h, SMOKE)
+    lit = name != "display"
+
+    def ink(on):
+        return VFD if lit and on else UNLIT
+    text = {"display": "88888888", "display_disc": "  Cd-i  ", "display_play": "01  0012"}[name]
+    for k, ch in enumerate(text):
+        if not lit:
+            ch = "8"
+        digit(reg, ch, 30.0 + 10.0 * k, 17.0, 7.0, 12.0, ink(ch != "8" or lit))
+    if name == "display_play":
+        reg.circle(30.0 + 10.0 * 5 + 8.6, 20.5, 0.6, VFD)
+        reg.circle(30.0 + 10.0 * 5 + 8.6, 25.5, 0.6, VFD)
+    playing = name == "display_play"
+    labels = [("MUTE", 14.0, 8.0, False), ("PAUSE", 14.0, 14.0, False), ("PLAY", 14.0, 20.0, playing),
+              ("SHUFFLE", 44.0, 9.0, False), ("REPEAT", 78.0, 11.0, False), ("SCAN", 104.0, 12.0, False),
+              ("TRACK", 38.0, 33.5, playing), ("TOTAL", 62.0, 33.5, False), ("TIME", 100.0, 33.5, playing)]
+    for word, x, y, on in labels:
+        reg.text(word, "arial.ttf", 2.4, x, y, ink(on))
+    reg.poly([(9.0, 23.0), (14.0, 26.0), (9.0, 29.0)], ink(playing))
+    for k, (word, on) in enumerate((("COMPACT DISC", lit), ("INTERACTIVE", lit), ("GRAPHICS", False))):
+        y = 15.0 + 5.2 * k
+        if k:
+            reg.rect_(116.0, y - 2.0, 136.0, y + 2.0, None, outline=ink(on), width=0.3)
+        reg.text(word, "arial.ttf", 2.2, 126.0, y, ink(on))
+    reg.text("CDI 220  CD-INTERACTIVE PLAYER", "arial.ttf", 2.0, 4.0, h - 3.2, (150, 120, 120), anchor="lm")
+    reg.text("PULL TO OPEN", "arial.ttf", 2.0, w - 4.0, h - 3.2, (150, 120, 120), anchor="rm")
+    sheen = reg.layer()
+    ImageDraw.Draw(sheen).rectangle(reg.box(0.0, 0.0, w, h * 0.18), fill=(255, 255, 255, 26))
+    reg.over(sheen)
+    return reg
+
+
+# ---- The disc, the gamepad ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def disc_top():
+    d = L.DISC["diameter"]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["disc_top"], d, d, (196, 200, 206))
+    c = d / 2
+    art = space((600, 600)).convert("RGB")
+    da = ImageDraw.Draw(art)
+    ship(da, 180, 330, 4.0, "#FFFFFF", "#FFB23C")
+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = reg.box(c - 58.0, c - 58.0, c + 58.0, c + 58.0)
+    mask = Image.new("L", reg.img.size, 0)
+    dm = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
+    dm.ellipse(reg.box(c - 58.0, c - 58.0, c + 58.0, c + 58.0), fill=255)
+    dm.ellipse(reg.box(c - 22.0, c - 22.0, c + 22.0, c + 22.0), fill=0)
+    layer = Image.new("RGBA", reg.img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
+    layer.paste(art.resize((round(x1 - x0), round(y1 - y0)), Image.LANCZOS), (round(x0), round(y0)))
+    reg.img.paste(layer, (0, 0), mask)
+    reg.circle(c, c, 22.0, outline=(150, 154, 160), width=0.4)
+    reg.text("ODYSSEY", "ariblk.ttf", 11.0, c, c - 36.0, (255, 214, 70))
+    disc_logo(reg, c + 26.0, c + 26.0, 12.0, (236, 236, 240))
+    reg.circle(c, c, 7.5, (60, 62, 66))
+    return reg
+
+
+def pad():
+    xs = [x for x, _ in L.PAD_OUTLINE]
+    w, d = max(xs) - min(xs), 101.0
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["pad"], w, d, CASE)
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + w / 2, d - y
+    ink = shade(CASE, -0.25)
+    p = L.PAD["dpad"]
+    cx, cy = at(*p["at"])
+    r = p["ring"] - 3.0
+    for k in range(4):                                       # the ring's triangles and dots
+        a = math.radians(90 * k)
+        tx, ty = cx + r * math.cos(a), cy - r * math.sin(a)
+        reg.poly([(tx + 1.4 * math.cos(a), ty - 1.4 * math.sin(a)),
+                  (tx - 1.2 * math.cos(a) + 1.3 * math.sin(a), ty + 1.2 * math.sin(a) + 1.3 * math.cos(a)),
+                  (tx - 1.2 * math.cos(a) - 1.3 * math.sin(a), ty + 1.2 * math.sin(a) - 1.3 * math.cos(a))], ink)
+        b = a + math.pi / 4
+        reg.circle(cx + r * math.cos(b), cy - r * math.sin(b), 0.6, ink)
+    reg.text("CD-i", "arialbi.ttf", 9.0, *at(2.0, 80.0), shade(CASE, -0.12))
+    for k, (bx, by) in enumerate(L.PAD["buttons"]["at"]):   # the buttons' dots
+        tx, ty = at(bx, by + L.PAD["buttons"]["r"] + 3.6)
+        text = ("•", "••", "•+••")[k]

+def main(out):

+
+

+    main(sys.argv[1])

+"""The console theme's Commodore CDTV system model (godot/themes/console/models/systems/cdtv.glb): the CDTV and its
+remote controller.
+
+Built in Blender (cdtv_layout.py has the measurements, taken from a period review and photographs). The case is a box on
+four silver feet, the front's foot a strip recessed under a ledge, the slot and the eject button's hole cut into the
+front; the display's faces and the LEDs sit on the front. The remote is a slab, its keys standing on its middle, the
+D-pad on its left end and A and B on its right. The printing is one texture (cdtv_print.py's), projected from in front
+onto the front and the display, and from above onto the top's grille, the remote and the caddy.
+
+A node tree: a root (the turn to a three-quarter view, TILT_YAW and TILT_PITCH: the right end towards the viewer, the
+top tipped up; then the model spec's fit: standing on y = 0, centred, the largest side 1 m) holding the set; the set
+holding the caddy (waiting in front of the slot, shrunk to nothing), the eject button, the two LEDs and the display's
+five faces (each lit one in front of the front face, the rest inside the case), and the remote's D-pad, A and B.
+
+The `focused` clip (8 s, looping): the caddy slides into the slot; the green LED comes on, the yellow one flickers while
+the disc is read, and the clock gives way to track 01, its time counting; the D-pad rocks and A and B fire; then the
+eject button, the caddy slides out and goes, and the clock is back.
+
+Three materials (case, remote, caddy) and one 1024² texture, within the system model budget. Run from the repo root:
+
+    python tools/console-models/cdtv_print.py artifacts/cdtv
+    blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/console-models/cdtv.py -- artifacts/cdtv godot/themes/console/models/systems/cdtv.glb
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Matrix, Vector
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import cdtv_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from amiga import paint, rounded, solid  # noqa: E402
+from clip import HIDDEN, Pose, back_out, ease_in, ease_out, key, phase, smooth  # noqa: E402
+from mega_drive_cartridge import bevel, boolean, box, export, join, material, triangles  # noqa: E402
+
+TILT_YAW = -24.0     # degrees about the vertical: the right end comes towards the viewer
+TILT_PITCH = 24.0    # degrees about the horizontal: the top tips up towards the viewer
+ROUGHNESS = dict(case=0.45, remote=0.5, caddy=0.35)
+FACES = ("clock", "time_0", "time_1", "time_2", "time_3")
+LIT, DARK = -0.3, 1.0     # where a lit face or LED sits (y): in front of the front face; and an unlit one, inside
+
+
+def atlas_uv(region, w, h):
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = region
+    return lambda a, b: ((rx + a / w * rw) / L.ATLAS, 1 - (ry + b / h * rh) / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def swatch(name):
+    x, y = L.SWATCHES[name]
+    return lambda co: (x / L.ATLAS, 1 - y / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def colour(obj, mat, name):
+    paint(obj, mat, swatch(name), lambda c, n, kind: True)
+    return obj
+
+
+FRONT = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["front"], L.WIDTH, L.HEIGHT - L.FEET["height"])
+VENTS = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["vents"], L.WIDTH, 130.0)
+
+
+def front_uv(co):
+    return FRONT(co.x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.HEIGHT - co.z)
+
+
+def disc(name, x, y, z0, z1, r, mat, segments=24):
+    ring = [(x + r * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / segments), y + r * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / segments))
+            for k in range(segments)]
+    return solid(name, [[(px, py, z) for px, py in ring] for z in (z0, z1)], mat)
+
+
+# ---- The CDTV --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def case(m):
+    """The case, the strip, the slot and the eject button's hole cut in; the feet; printed."""
+    half, foot = L.WIDTH / 2, L.FEET["height"]
+    body = box("cdtv", -half, half, 0.0, L.DEPTH, foot, L.HEIGHT, m["case"])
+    bevel(body, 1.5, segments=2)
+    z0, z1 = L.STRIP["z"]
+    boolean(body, box("strip", -half - 1.0, half + 1.0, -1.0, L.STRIP["depth"], z0 - 1.0, z1, m["case"]))
+    (sx0, sx1), (sz0, sz1) = L.SLOT["x"], L.SLOT["z"]
+    boolean(body, box("slot", sx0, sx1, -1.0, L.SLOT["depth"], sz0, sz1, m["case"]))
+    (ex0, ex1), (ez0, ez1) = L.EJECT["x"], L.EJECT["z"]
+    boolean(body, box("eject_hole", ex0, ex1, -1.0, L.EJECT["depth"], ez0, ez1, m["case"]))
+    colour(body, m["case"], "case")
+    paint(body, m["case"], front_uv, lambda c, n, kind: n.y < -0.9)
+    paint(body, m["case"], lambda co: VENTS(co.x + half, 320.0 - co.y), lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9 and c.y > 190.0)
+
+    def inside(c):
+        """In the slot or the eject button's hole."""
+        return (sx0 - 0.5 < c.x < sx1 + 0.5 and sz0 - 0.5 < c.z < sz1 + 0.5
+                or ex0 - 0.5 < c.x < ex1 + 0.5 and ez0 - 0.5 < c.z < ez1 + 0.5)
+    paint(body, m["case"], swatch("dark"), lambda c, n, kind: c.y > 0.5 and inside(c))
+    feet = [colour(disc("foot", side * L.FEET["x"], y, 0.0, foot + 1.0, L.FEET["r"], m["case"]), m["case"], "silver")
+            for side in (-1, 1) for y in L.FEET["y"]]
+    return join([body] + feet, "cdtv")
+
+
+def face(m, name):
+    """One of the display's faces, facing the viewer, its middle at its origin."""
+    (x0, x1), (z0, z1) = L.DISPLAY["x"], L.DISPLAY["z"]
+    w, h = x1 - x0, z1 - z0
+    part = box(name, -w / 2, w / 2, -0.1, 0.1, -h / 2, h / 2, m["case"])
+    colour(part, m["case"], "dark")
+    uv = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS[name], w, h)
+    paint(part, m["case"], lambda co: uv(co.x + w / 2, h / 2 - co.z), lambda c, n, kind: n.y < -0.9)
+    return part
+
+
+def led(m, name):
+    r = L.LEDS["r"]
+    part = disc(name, 0.0, 0.0, -0.1, 0.1, r, m["case"], 12)
+    part.data.transform(Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90.0), 4, "X"))
+    return colour(part, m["case"], name)
+
+
+def eject(m):
+    """The eject button, its front's middle at its origin."""
+    (ex0, ex1), (ez0, ez1) = L.EJECT["x"], L.EJECT["z"]
+    w, h = ex1 - ex0 - 1.0, ez1 - ez0 - 1.0
+    part = box("eject", -w / 2, w / 2, 0.0, 3.0, -h / 2, h / 2, m["case"])
+    bevel(part, 0.5, segments=1)
+    return colour(part, m["case"], "key")
+
+
+def caddy(m):
+    """The caddy, lying flat, its leading edge's middle at its origin, its top printed (the disc through its window)."""
+    w, length, t = L.CADDY["size"]
+    part = box("caddy", -w / 2, w / 2, -length, 0.0, -t / 2, t / 2, m["caddy"])
+    bevel(part, 1.2, segments=2)
+    colour(part, m["caddy"], "caddy")
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["caddy"], w, length)
+    paint(part, m["caddy"], lambda co: top(co.x + w / 2, -co.y), lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9)
+    return part
+
+
+# ---- The remote ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def remote(m):
+    """The remote at its place: the slab, its keys; the D-pad, A and B apart (each with where it goes)."""
+    length, depth, height = L.REMOTE["size"]
+    x, y, turn = L.REMOTE["at"]
+    place = Matrix.Translation((x, y, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(turn), 4, "Z")
+    slab = solid("remote", [[(px, py, 0.0) for px, py in rounded(0.0, 0.0, length, depth, 10.0, 4)],
+                            [(px, py, height) for px, py in rounded(0.0, 0.0, length - 4.0, depth - 4.0, 8.0, 4)]],
+                 m["remote"])
+    bevel(slab, 1.5, segments=2)
+    colour(slab, m["remote"], "remote")
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["remote"], length, depth)
+    paint(slab, m["remote"], lambda co: top(co.x + length / 2, depth / 2 - co.y), lambda c, n, kind: n.z > 0.9)
+    parts = [slab]
+    kw, kh = L.REMOTE["key"]
+    for (kx, ky), name in zip(L.KEYS, L.KEY_NAMES):
+        part = box("key", kx - kw / 2, kx + kw / 2, ky - kh / 2, ky + kh / 2, height - 1.0, height + 2.2, m["remote"])
+        bevel(part, 0.6, segments=1)
+        parts.append(colour(part, m["remote"], "red" if name == "POWER" else "key"))
+    whole = join(parts, "remote")
+    whole.data.transform(place)
+
+    px, py, reach, arm = L.REMOTE["pad"]
+    cross = join([box("arm", -reach, reach, -arm / 2, arm / 2, -1.0, 4.0, m["remote"]),
+                  box("arm", -arm / 2, arm / 2, -reach, reach, -1.0, 4.0, m["remote"])], "pad")
+    bevel(cross, 1.2, segments=2, angle=30)
+    colour(cross, m["remote"], "remote")
+    moving = {"pad": (cross, place @ Vector((px, py, height)))}
+    for name in ("a", "b"):
+        bx, by = L.REMOTE[name]
+        part = disc(name, 0.0, 0.0, -1.0, 3.0, L.REMOTE["r"], m["remote"], 20)
+        bevel(part, 0.8, segments=2)
+        moving[name] = (colour(part, m["remote"], "remote"), place @ Vector((bx, by, height)))
+    for part, _ in moving.values():
+        part.data.transform(Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(turn), 4, "Z"))
+    return whole, moving
+
+
+# ---- The focused clip ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def tap(f, f0, hold=2):
+    return smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 3)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f0 + 3 + hold, f0 + 7 + hold)))
+
+
+def shown(f):
+    if f < 60 or f >= 176:
+        return "clock"
+    return "time_%d" % min(3, (f - 60) // 30)
+
+
+def timeline(f):
+    out, up = L.CADDY["out"], 30.0
+    if f < 10 or f >= 198:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, z=up, scale=HIDDEN)
+    elif f < 17:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, z=up, scale=max(HIDDEN, back_out(phase(f, 10, 17))))
+    elif f < 24:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, z=up * (1 - ease_in(phase(f, 17, 24))))
+    elif f < 176:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 24, 42))))
+    elif f < 190:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out * smooth(phase(f, 176, 190)))
+    else:
+        disk = Pose(y=-out, z=up * ease_out(phase(f, 190, 198)), scale=max(HIDDEN, 1 - ease_in(phase(f, 194, 198))))
+    poses = {"caddy": disk, "eject": Pose(y=1.8 * tap(f, 170))}
+    for name in FACES:
+        poses[name] = Pose() if name == shown(f) else Pose(y=DARK - LIT)
+    playing = 44 <= f < 174
+    reading = 46 <= f < 90 and (f // 3) % 3 != 2
+    poses["green"] = Pose() if playing else Pose(y=DARK - LIT)
+    poses["yellow"] = Pose() if reading else Pose(y=DARK - LIT)
+    t = phase(f, 70, 168)
+    k = math.sin(math.pi * t)
+    poses["pad"] = Pose(pitch=7.0 * k * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 3.0 * t), roll=7.0 * k * math.cos(2 * math.pi * 2.0 * t))
+    poses["a"] = Pose(z=-1.8 * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in (84, 104, 124, 144)))
+    poses["b"] = Pose(z=-1.8 * max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in (96, 136, 156)))
+    return poses
+
+
+# ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
+    images, out = os.path.abspath(args[0]), os.path.abspath(args[1])
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.render.fps = L.FPS
+    atlas = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "cdtv_print.png"))
+    m = {name: material(name, L.COLOURS["print"], r, atlas) for name, r in ROUGHNESS.items()}
+
+    controller, moving = remote(m)
+    whole = join([case(m), controller], "cdtv")
+    for p in whole.data.polygons:
+        p.use_smooth = p.area < 400.0                     # the big flat faces flat
+    whole.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("cdtv_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    (sx0, sx1), (sz0, sz1) = L.SLOT["x"], L.SLOT["z"]
+    w, length, _ = L.CADDY["size"]
+    moving["caddy"] = (caddy(m), Vector(((sx0 + sx1) / 2, length - L.CADDY["proud"], (sz0 + sz1) / 2)))
+    (ex0, ex1), (ez0, ez1) = L.EJECT["x"], L.EJECT["z"]
+    moving["eject"] = (eject(m), Vector(((ex0 + ex1) / 2, -1.0, (ez0 + ez1) / 2)))
+    (dx0, dx1), (dz0, dz1) = L.DISPLAY["x"], L.DISPLAY["z"]
+    for name in FACES:
+        moving[name] = (face(m, name), Vector(((dx0 + dx1) / 2, LIT, (dz0 + dz1) / 2)))
+    for name in ("green", "yellow"):
+        lx, lz = L.LEDS[name]
+        moving[name] = (led(m, name), Vector((lx, LIT, lz)))
+    nodes = {}
+    for name, (part, where) in moving.items():
+        for p in part.data.polygons:
+            p.use_smooth = True
+        part.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+        nodes[name] = part
+
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole] + list(nodes.values())
+    print(f"CDTV: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The Commodore CDTV card's measurements, shared by cdtv_print.py (which draws its printing) and cdtv.py (which builds
+it). Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+
+The Commodore CDTV (1991), 430 mm wide, 330 deep and 95 high on its 15 mm silver feet (a 1993 review's figures), its
+remote controller in front of it, a CD caddy with a made-up game, Odyssey, going into its slot. Millimetres: x from its
+middle (left to right), y back from its front, z up from the table. The front's layout was measured from photographs on
+Wikimedia Commons (one straight on, under a 1084 monitor; one from the front left; its controls close up; the remote),
+scaled by its width; the review gives the front's order from left to right.
+
+The case: black, a box on four silver feet (FEET), the front's foot a recessed strip (STRIP) under a ledge with the
+small buttons; the top's back half a vent grille (VENTS). On the front, from the left: the power switch over the
+headphone jack (POWER, JACK), the green LED, the caddy's panel (PANEL) with the slot (SLOT) and the eject button under
+its right end (EJECT), the yellow LED, the infrared window (IR), the cyan display (DISPLAY: the clock, then the track
+and its time), the play and stop buttons, the volume rocker, and Commodore CDTV over them. The remote (REMOTE): a long
+black slab, the D-pad on its left end, A and B on its right, the keys between (KEYS).
+
+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `front` (the front: its panels, labels and buttons' faces), `vents` (the top's
+grille), `remote` (the remote from above), `caddy` (the caddy's top: the disc through its window), the display's faces
+(`clock`, `time_0` to `time_3`), and swatches. A region is (x, y, width, height) in pixels.
+"""
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 430.0, 330.0, 95.0
+FEET = dict(height=15.0, r=16.0, x=180.0, y=(40.0, 290.0))
+STRIP = dict(z=(FEET["height"], 27.0), depth=3.0)
+VENTS = dict(y=(200.0, 310.0), x=(-180.0, 180.0))
+
+POWER = dict(x=(-207.0, -184.0), z=(65.0, 75.0))
+JACK = dict(at=(-196.0, 42.0), r=4.0)
+LEDS = dict(green=(-173.0, 69.0), yellow=(-29.0, 69.0), r=1.6)
+PANEL = dict(x=(-169.0, -35.0), z=(27.0, 79.0))
+SLOT = dict(x=(-164.0, -36.0), z=(52.0, 62.0), depth=170.0)
+EJECT = dict(x=(-58.0, -40.0), z=(39.0, 47.0), depth=2.5)
+IR = dict(x=(-21.0, 8.0), z=(43.0, 57.0))
+DISPLAY = dict(x=(15.0, 77.0), z=(43.0, 57.0))
+PLAY = dict(x=(85.0, 119.0), z=(50.0, 61.0))
+STOP = dict(x=(85.0, 119.0), z=(36.0, 47.0))
+VOLUME = dict(x=(125.0, 201.0), z=(36.0, 61.0))
+LOGO = dict(x=(110.0, 205.0), z=(70.0, 88.0))
+SMALL = dict(x=[(85.0, 101.0), (103.0, 119.0), (140.0, 165.0), (170.0, 195.0)], z=(19.0, 24.0),
+             names=["◄◄", "►►", "CD/TV", "RESET"])
+
+# The caddy: w, length (going in), t; how far out of the slot its front end stays when it is in; how far out it waits.
+CADDY = dict(size=(124.0, 155.0, 8.6), proud=2.0, out=165.0, window=(112.0, 124.0), disc=60.0)
+
+# The remote: length, depth, height; where its middle lies (x, y) and its turn; its end sections' length; the D-pad
+# (its middle along the left end, its arms' reach and width), A and B (their middles, radius), the keys (their size).
+REMOTE = dict(size=(216.0, 70.0, 20.0), at=(-40.0, -62.0, -5.0), ends=36.0, pad=(-90.0, 4.0, 13.0, 8.0),
+              a=(82.0, -2.0), b=(98.0, 6.0), r=6.0, key=(11.0, 6.0))
+# The keys on the remote's middle (their middles, from its middle): the number pad (1 2 3 ESCAPE, 4 5 6 0, 7 8 9
+# ENTER), the CD keys (GENLOCK CD/TV POWER, REW PLAY FF), STOP, and the volume pair; POWER is red.
+KEYS = ([(-58.0 + 16.5 * c, 20.0 - 11.0 * r) for r in range(3) for c in range(4)]
+        + [(10.0 + 15.0 * c, 20.0 - 11.0 * r) for r in range(2) for c in range(3)]
+        + [(25.0, -13.0), (58.0, 9.0), (58.0, -4.0)])
+KEY_NAMES = ["1", "2", "3", "ESCAPE", "4", "5", "6", "0", "7", "8", "9", "ENTER", "GENLOCK", "CD/TV", "POWER", "REW",
+             "PLAY/PAUSE", "FF", "STOP", "▲", "▼"]
+
+COLOURS = dict(case="#1C1C1E", print="#FFFFFF")
+
+REGIONS = dict(front=(0, 0, 1024, 192), vents=(0, 200, 1024, 316), remote=(0, 524, 648, 210),
+               caddy=(656, 524, 248, 310), clock=(0, 744, 248, 56), time_0=(256, 744, 248, 56),
+               time_1=(0, 808, 248, 56), time_2=(256, 808, 248, 56), time_3=(0, 872, 248, 56))
+SWATCHES = dict(case=(912, 880), silver=(944, 880), dark=(976, 880), key=(1008, 880), red=(912, 912),
+                green=(944, 912), yellow=(976, 912), remote=(1008, 912), caddy=(912, 944), off=(944, 944))
+
+FPS = 30
+LENGTH = 240                 # 8 s

+"""The Commodore CDTV card's printing (cdtv_print.png), for the console theme's model (cdtv.py).
+
+One image, laid out as cdtv_layout.REGIONS says: the front (the power switch and the headphone jack, the LEDs, the
+caddy's panel with the Compact Disc mark, the infrared window, the play, stop and volume buttons' faces, Commodore CDTV,
+the small buttons' labels on the strip), the top's vent grille, the remote from above (its frame, its name, the keys'
+labels, the end sections' ribs), the caddy's top (a made-up game, Odyssey, through its window), the display's faces (the
+clock, then the track and its time, in cyan), and swatches. Run it with the system Python (Pillow):
+
+    python tools/console-models/cdtv_print.py <out folder>
+"""
+
+import os
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import cdtv_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from psp_print import ship, space  # noqa: E402
+from retro_pc_print import rgb  # noqa: E402
+from windows_pc_print import Region  # noqa: E402
+
+CASE = rgb(L.COLOURS["case"])
+PANEL = (36, 36, 39)
+GREY = (150, 150, 152)
+WHITE = (226, 226, 222)
+GOLD = (214, 176, 96)
+CYAN = (80, 220, 255)
+KEY = (128, 126, 122)
+
+
+def shade(colour, k):
+    return tuple(max(0, min(255, round(c * (1 + k)))) for c in colour)
+
+
+def chicken_head(reg, x, y, h, ink):
+    """Commodore's mark, h tall, its middle at (x, y): the C, and the flag's two halves in its mouth."""
+    r = h / 2
+    reg.circle(x, y, r, ink)
+    reg.circle(x + 0.12 * h, y, r * 0.58, CASE)
+    reg.rect_(x + 0.05 * h, y - 0.36 * h, x + 0.6 * h, y + 0.36 * h, CASE)
+    reg.poly([(x + 0.12 * h, y - 0.05 * h), (x + 0.5 * h, y - 0.05 * h), (x + 0.5 * h, y - 0.3 * h)], ink)
+    reg.poly([(x + 0.12 * h, y + 0.05 * h), (x + 0.5 * h, y + 0.05 * h), (x + 0.5 * h, y + 0.3 * h)], (190, 40, 40))
+
+
+def compact_disc(reg, x, y, h, ink):
+    """The Compact Disc mark, h tall, its middle at (x, y)."""
+    reg.text("COMPACT", "arialbd.ttf", h * 0.22, x, y - h * 0.34, ink)
+    reg.text("disc", "ariblk.ttf", h * 0.62, x, y + h * 0.14, ink)
+    reg.line([(x - h * 0.9, y - h * 0.5), (x + h * 0.9, y - h * 0.5)], ink, h * 0.05)
+
+
+def front():
+    """The front: x across (-WIDTH/2 at the left), z down from its top."""
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["front"], L.WIDTH, L.HEIGHT - L.FEET["height"], CASE)
+
+    def at(x, z):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.HEIGHT - z
+
+    z0, z1 = L.STRIP["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(-L.WIDTH / 2, z1), *at(L.WIDTH / 2, z0), shade(CASE, -0.25))
+    reg.line([at(-L.WIDTH / 2, z1 - 0.3), at(L.WIDTH / 2, z1 - 0.3)], shade(CASE, 0.6), 0.4)
+    for (x0, x1), name in zip(L.SMALL["x"], L.SMALL["names"]):
+        za, zb = L.SMALL["z"]
+        reg.rect_(*at(x0, zb), *at(x1, za), shade(CASE, 0.25), r=0.6)
+        reg.text(name, "seguisym.ttf" if "◄" in name or "►" in name else "arialbd.ttf", 2.4,
+                 *at((x0 + x1) / 2, zb + 2.0), GREY)
+
+    (px0, px1), (pz0, pz1) = L.POWER["x"], L.POWER["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(px0, pz1), *at(px1, pz0), shade(CASE, 0.35), r=1.0)
+    reg.rect_(*at(px0 + 1.5, pz1 - 1.5), *at(px0 + 9.0, pz0 + 1.5), shade(CASE, 0.6), r=0.6)
+    reg.text("POWER", "arialbd.ttf", 2.2, *at((px0 + px1) / 2, pz1 + 2.6), GREY)
+    jx, jz = L.JACK["at"]
+    reg.circle(*at(jx, jz), L.JACK["r"] + 1.2, shade(CASE, 0.5))
+    reg.circle(*at(jx, jz), L.JACK["r"], (6, 6, 6))
+    reg.text("∩", "seguisym.ttf", 3.0, *at(jx, jz + 7.0), GREY)
+    for name in ("green", "yellow"):
+        lx, lz = L.LEDS[name]
+        reg.circle(*at(lx, lz), L.LEDS["r"], (40, 60, 40) if name == "green" else (70, 60, 30))
+
+    (cx0, cx1), (cz0, cz1) = L.PANEL["x"], L.PANEL["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(cx0, cz1), *at(cx1, cz0), PANEL, r=1.0)
+    compact_disc(reg, *at((cx0 + cx1) / 2, cz1 - 9.0), 9.0, GREY)
+    (sx0, sx1), (sz0, sz1) = L.SLOT["x"], L.SLOT["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(sx0, sz1), *at(sx1, sz0), (6, 6, 6))
+    (ex0, ex1), (ez0, ez1) = L.EJECT["x"], L.EJECT["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(ex0 - 1.0, ez1 + 1.0), *at(ex1 + 1.0, ez0 - 1.0), (10, 10, 10), r=0.8)
+
+    (ix0, ix1), (iz0, iz1) = L.IR["x"], L.IR["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(ix0, iz1), *at(ix1, iz0), (32, 8, 10), r=1.0)
+    reg.text("CD", "arialbd.ttf", 2.6, *at(ix0 + 7.0, (iz0 + iz1) / 2), (110, 40, 40))
+    (dx0, dx1), (dz0, dz1) = L.DISPLAY["x"], L.DISPLAY["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(dx0 - 1.0, dz1 + 1.0), *at(dx1 + 1.0, dz0 - 1.0), (8, 10, 12), r=1.0)
+
+    for box, label in ((L.PLAY, "► ❘❘"), (L.STOP, "■")):
+        (bx0, bx1), (bz0, bz1) = box["x"], box["z"]
+        reg.rect_(*at(bx0, bz1), *at(bx1, bz0), shade(CASE, 0.3), r=1.0)
+        reg.text(label, "seguisym.ttf", 4.0, *at((bx0 + bx1) / 2, (bz0 + bz1) / 2),
+                 (200, 50, 40) if label == "■" else WHITE)
+    (vx0, vx1), (vz0, vz1) = L.VOLUME["x"], L.VOLUME["z"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(vx0, vz1), *at(vx1, vz0), shade(CASE, 0.3), r=1.0)
+    mid = (vx0 + vx1) / 2
+    reg.line([at(mid + 4.0, vz1), at(mid - 4.0, vz0)], shade(CASE, -0.4), 0.8)
+    reg.text("▼ DOWN", "seguisym.ttf", 3.2, *at(vx0 + 16.0, vz1 - 6.0), WHITE)
+    reg.text("UP ▲", "seguisym.ttf", 3.2, *at(vx1 - 14.0, vz1 - 6.0), WHITE)
+    reg.text("∩ VOLUME", "seguisym.ttf", 2.8, *at(mid, vz1 + 3.0), GREY)
+
+    (lx0, lx1), (lz0, lz1) = L.LOGO["x"], L.LOGO["z"]
+    chicken_head(reg, *at(lx0 + 6.0, lz1 - 5.0), 8.0, GOLD)
+    reg.text("Commodore", "arialbd.ttf", 9.0, *at(lx0 + 12.0, lz1 - 5.0), WHITE, anchor="lm")
+    reg.text("CDTV", "arial.ttf", 7.0, *at(lx1 - 2.0, lz0 + 3.5), GREY, anchor="rm")
+    return reg
+
+
+def vents():
+    """The top's back from above: x across, y down from the back edge; the grille's rows of slots."""
+    y0, y1 = 190.0, 320.0
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["vents"], L.WIDTH, y1 - y0, CASE)
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, y1 - y
+
+    (vx0, vx1), (vy0, vy1) = L.VENTS["x"], L.VENTS["y"]
+    rows, cols = 6, 36
+    for r in range(rows):
+        for c in range(cols):
+            x = vx0 + (vx1 - vx0) * (c + 0.5) / cols
+            y = vy0 + (vy1 - vy0) * (r + 0.5) / rows
+            reg.rect_(*at(x - 2.2, y + 6.0), *at(x + 2.2, y - 6.0), (6, 6, 7), r=1.6)
+    return reg
+
+
+def remote():
+    """The remote from above: x along it (-length/2 at the left), y down from its back edge."""
+    length, depth, _ = L.REMOTE["size"]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["remote"], length, depth, (30, 30, 34))
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + length / 2, depth / 2 - y
+
+    ends = L.REMOTE["ends"]
+    for side in (-1, 1):                                    # the end sections' ribs

+"""The console theme's Fairchild Channel F system model (godot/themes/console/models/systems/channelf.glb): the Channel
+F and its two controllers.
+
+Built in Blender (channelf_layout.py has the measurements, taken from photographs). The console is its side outline
+extruded across its width and cut to its sides sloping in to the foot: walnut on the sides and the front's plinth, black
+on top; the slot is cut into the lid's front face and runs back under the lid, its door hinged along its top. The keys,
+the INSERT CARTRIDGE plate and the eject bar stand on the front panel, the chrome strip on the lid. The controllers are
+each a rounded grip, a neck and a knob, lying on their sides, their cables wired into the console's left side, each
+through a strain relief at both ends (plugs.py's). The printing is one texture (channelf_print.py's), projected from
+above onto the panel, its keys, the plate, the bar, the strip and the Videocart, from in front onto the door, and along
+the walnut and the grips.
+
+A node tree: a root (the turn to a three-quarter view, TILT_YAW and TILT_PITCH: the right end towards the viewer, the
+top tipped up; then the model spec's fit: standing on y = 0, centred, the largest side 1 m) holding the set; the set
+holding the Videocart (waiting in front of the slot, shrunk to nothing), the door, RESET and 1, the eject bar, and the
+first controller's knob.
+
+The `focused` clip (8 s, looping): the Videocart comes down in front of the slot and slides in, pushing the door in;
+RESET, then 1 (hockey); the first controller's knob tilts and pushes; then Press to Eject, the Videocart slides back
+out, the door shuts behind it, and it goes.
+
+Three materials (plastic, walnut, cart) and one 1024² texture, within the system model budget. Run from the repo root:
+
+    python tools/console-models/channelf_print.py artifacts/channelf
+    blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/console-models/channelf.py -- artifacts/channelf godot/themes/console/models/systems/channelf.glb

+def atlas_uv(region, w, h):
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = region

+
+def swatch(name):

+    plate = prism_x("plate", [(py0, L.panel_z(py0) - 1.0), (py1, L.panel_z(py1) - 1.0), (py1, L.panel_z(py1) + h),

+    for k, place in enumerate(L.CONTROLLER["at"]):
+        grip, live, exit_ = controller(m, place, k == 0)
+        moving.update(live)
+        turn = math.radians(place[2])
+        relief, start, leaving = plugs.place(*plugs.grommet(black, 4.2), m["plastic"], exit_,
+                                             (-math.cos(turn), -math.sin(turn), 0.0))
+        z, y = L.PORT["z"], L.PORT["y"] - 26.0 * k                         # the controllers are wired in
+        entry = Vector((-L.WIDTH / 2 + L.SIDE["foot"] * (1 - z / L.HEIGHT), y, z))
+        sleeve, end, back = plugs.place(*plugs.grommet(black, 4.6), m["plastic"], entry, side)
+        parts += [grip, cable("cable", m, [start, start + leaving * 50.0 + Vector((0.0, 0.0, -10.0)),
+                                           end + back * 60.0 + Vector((0.0, 0.0, -20.0)), end])] + relief + sleeve
+    whole = join(parts, "channelf")
+    for p in whole.data.polygons:
+        p.use_smooth = True
+    whole.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("channelf_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    (x0, x1), (z0, _) = L.SLOT["x"], L.SLOT["z"]
+    moving["videocart"] = (videocart(m), Vector(((x0 + x1) / 2, L.CART["front"], z0 + 1.0)))
+    moving["door"] = door(m)
+    nodes = {}
+    for name, (part, where) in moving.items():
+        for p in part.data.polygons:
+            p.use_smooth = True
+        part.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+        nodes[name] = part
+
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole] + list(nodes.values())
+    print(f"Channel F: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The Fairchild Channel F card's measurements, shared by channelf_print.py (which draws its printing) and channelf.py
+(which builds it). Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+
+The Fairchild Channel F (1976), the first one, 305 mm wide, 330 deep and 89 high (the Computer History Museum's 3.5 x 12
+x 13 inches), its two controllers lying in front of it, a Videocart (the size of an 8-track tape, as they were made)
+with a made-up game, Odyssey, going into its slot. Millimetres: x from its middle (left to right), y back from its
+front, z up from the table. Measured from photographs on Wikimedia Commons (Evan-Amos's from the front left; one
+straight down on it; others from the front and of its Videocarts).
+
+The console: walnut sides and front, sloping in to its foot all round (SIDE), the black top between them (PROFILE): the
+front panel sloping gently up to the lid, the lid over the controllers' compartment behind it, its glossy top with the
+chrome strip (FAIRCHILD, VIDEO ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM). On the panel: RESET and the keys 1 to 4 (KEYS), and at its right
+the cartridge's door in the lid's front face (SLOT, DOOR, hinged along its top), the INSERT CARTRIDGE plate in front of
+it and the Press to Eject bar (PLATE, EJECT). The controllers are the pistol grips, each with its knob on its neck at
+one end (CONTROLLER), lying on their sides, their cables running to the console's left side.
+
+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `panel` (the front panel from above: the keys' tops, TIME MODE HOLD START and the
+rest, INSERT CARTRIDGE, Press to Eject), `strip` (the lid's chrome strip from above), `door` (the cartridge door's
+ribbed face), `cart` (the Videocart's top: its label), `wood` (the walnut's grain), `grip` (a controller's ribbed side)
+and swatches. A region is (x, y, width, height) in pixels.
+"""
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 305.0, 330.0, 89.0
+SIDE = dict(foot=15.0, black=44.0)    # how far the walnut slopes in at the foot; the walnut's top at the front
+PANEL = dict(front=(4.0, 47.0), back=(83.0, 52.0))      # the front panel's front and back edges (y, z)
+LID = dict(y=85.0, top=HEIGHT)
+PROFILE = [                           # the side outline (y, z), round from the front's foot
+    (SIDE["foot"], 0.0), (DEPTH - SIDE["foot"], 0.0), (DEPTH, HEIGHT - 6.0), (DEPTH - 3.0, HEIGHT),
+    (LID["y"] + 3.0, HEIGHT), (LID["y"], HEIGHT - 3.0), (LID["y"], PANEL["back"][1] + 2.0), PANEL["back"],
+    PANEL["front"], (0.0, SIDE["black"]),
+]
+STRIP = dict(x=(-135.0, 136.0), y=(252.0, 276.0))
+
+KEYS = dict(x=[-102.4, -81.1, -61.0, -42.1, -22.0], y=39.0, size=13.0, height=5.0,
+            names=["RESET", "1", "2", "3", "4"])
+SLOT = dict(x=(12.0, 118.0), z=(52.0, 78.0), depth=125.0)     # the mouth in the lid's front face; how far it runs back
+DOOR = dict(inset=1.0, open=80.0)                               # its gap round the mouth; how far it swings in
+PLATE = dict(x=(22.0, 108.0), y=(58.0, 82.0), height=2.0)
+EJECT = dict(x=(27.0, 119.0), y=(18.0, 36.0), height=4.0)
+
+# The Videocart: w, length, t; its front end's y when it is in; how far out in front of that it waits.
+CART = dict(size=(102.0, 137.0, 22.0), front=45.0, out=110.0)
+# The controllers: the grip's length, width and height; the neck's radius and length; the knob's width, height and
+# thickness; where each lies (x, y of its grip's middle) and its turn (degrees).
+CONTROLLER = dict(grip=(150.0, 42.0, 34.0), neck=(8.0, 12.0), knob=(46.0, 42.0, 18.0),
+                  at=[(-118.0, -66.0, -16.0), (-80.0, -122.0, -22.0)])
+PORT = dict(y=250.0, z=30.0)          # where the cables go into the console's left side
+
+COLOURS = dict(black="#151517", wood="#5A3420", cart="#F2C230", print="#FFFFFF")
+
+REGIONS = dict(panel=(0, 0, 800, 236), strip=(0, 244, 800, 62), door=(0, 314, 280, 70), cart=(0, 392, 206, 276),
+               wood=(216, 392, 400, 160), grip=(216, 560, 400, 110))
+SWATCHES = dict(black=(912, 400), wood=(944, 400), cream=(976, 400), yellow=(1008, 400), cart=(912, 432),
+                chrome=(944, 432), dark=(976, 432), gloss=(1008, 432))
+
+FPS = 30
+LENGTH = 240                 # 8 s
+
+
+def panel_z(y):
+    """The front panel's height at y."""
+    (y0, z0), (y1, z1) = PANEL["front"], PANEL["back"]
+    return z0 + (y - y0) * (z1 - z0) / (y1 - y0)

+"""The Fairchild Channel F card's printing (channelf_print.png), for the console theme's model (channelf.py).
+
+One image, laid out as channelf_layout.REGIONS says: the front panel from above (RESET and the keys' tops, TIME MODE
+HOLD START, the times, HOCKEY TENNIS GAME 3 GAME 4, INSERT CARTRIDGE, Press to Eject), the lid's chrome strip, the
+cartridge door's ribs, the Videocart's top (its label: a made-up game, Odyssey), the walnut's grain, a controller's
+ribbed grip, and swatches. Run it with the system Python (Pillow):
+
+    python tools/console-models/channelf_print.py <out folder>
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import channelf_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from psp_print import ship, space  # noqa: E402
+from retro_pc_print import rgb  # noqa: E402
+from windows_pc_print import Region  # noqa: E402
+
+BLACK = rgb(L.COLOURS["black"])
+WOOD = rgb(L.COLOURS["wood"])
+CART = rgb(L.COLOURS["cart"])
+WHITE = (232, 232, 226)
+CREAM = (232, 226, 200)
+YELLOW = (232, 188, 40)
+CHROME = (200, 200, 196)
+
+
+def panel():
+    """The front panel from above: x across, y down from the lid's front face to the panel's front edge."""
+    back = L.LID["y"]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["panel"], L.WIDTH, back, BLACK)
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, back - y
+
+    xs, y, k = L.KEYS["x"], L.KEYS["y"], L.KEYS["size"] / 2
+    reg.rect_(*at(xs[0] - 13.0, 62.0), *at(xs[-1] + 13.0, 18.0), (30, 30, 32), r=2.0)
+    for word, x in zip(("TIME", "MODE", "HOLD", "START"), xs[1:]):
+        reg.text(word, "arialbd.ttf", 3.4, *at(x, 57.0), WHITE)
+    reg.text("RESET", "arialbd.ttf", 3.0, *at(xs[0], 51.5), YELLOW)
+    for word, x in zip(("2 MIN", "5 MIN", "10 MIN", "20 MIN"), xs[1:]):
+        reg.text(word, "arialbd.ttf", 2.6, *at(x, 51.5), WHITE)
+    for ly in (48.5, 29.0):
+        reg.line([at(xs[0] - 8.0, ly), at(xs[-1] + 8.0, ly)], (160, 156, 140), 0.3)
+    for word, x in zip(("HOCKEY", "TENNIS", "GAME 3", "GAME 4"), xs[1:]):
+        reg.text(word, "arialbd.ttf", 2.6, *at(x, 25.5), WHITE)
+    for x, name in zip(xs, L.KEYS["names"]):
+        reg.rect_(*at(x - k, y + k), *at(x + k, y - k), YELLOW if name == "RESET" else CREAM, r=1.6)
+        if name != "RESET":
+            reg.text(name, "arialbd.ttf", 6.0, *at(x, y), BLACK)
+
+    (px0, px1), (py0, py1) = L.PLATE["x"], L.PLATE["y"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(px0, py1), *at(px1, py0), (12, 12, 14), r=3.0)
+    reg.rect_(*at(px0 + 4.0, py1 - 3.0), *at(px1 - 4.0, py0 + 3.0), None, r=3.0, outline=(214, 190, 120), width=0.5)
+    mx, my = (px0 + px1) / 2, (py0 + py1) / 2
+    reg.text("INSERT", "arialbd.ttf", 3.2, *at(mx - 6.0, my), WHITE, anchor="rm")
+    reg.text("CARTRIDGE", "arialbd.ttf", 3.2, *at(mx + 6.0, my), WHITE, anchor="lm")
+    reg.line([at(mx - 3.0, my - 1.4), at(mx, my + 1.6), at(mx + 3.0, my - 1.4)], WHITE, 0.5)
+    (ex0, ex1), (ey0, ey1) = L.EJECT["x"], L.EJECT["y"]
+    reg.rect_(*at(ex0, ey1), *at(ex1, ey0), (22, 22, 24), r=1.0)
+    for k in range(7):
+        for x0 in (ex0 + 2.0, ex1 - 17.0):
+            yy = ey0 + 2.5 + k * (ey1 - ey0 - 5.0) / 6
+            reg.line([at(x0, yy), at(x0 + 15.0, yy)], (60, 60, 62), 0.5)
+    reg.rect_(*at(ex0 + 20.0, ey1 - 4.0), *at(ex1 - 20.0, ey0 + 4.0), (40, 40, 42), r=1.0)
+    reg.text("Press to Eject", "arialbd.ttf", 3.6, *at((ex0 + ex1) / 2, (ey0 + ey1) / 2), WHITE)
+    return reg
+
+
+def strip():
+    """The lid's chrome strip from above: x across, y down from its back edge."""
+    (x0, x1), (y0, y1) = L.STRIP["x"], L.STRIP["y"]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["strip"], L.WIDTH, y1 - y0, BLACK)
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, y1 - y
+
+    reg.rect_(*at(x0, y1), *at(x1, y0), (18, 18, 20), r=1.5)
+    for ly in (y0 + 2.5, y1 - 2.5):
+        reg.line([at(x0 + 3.0, ly), at(x1 - 3.0, ly)], CHROME, 0.7)
+    my = (y0 + y1) / 2
+    reg.rect_(*at(-112.0, my + 4.0), *at(-74.0, my - 4.0), CHROME)
+    for k in range(3):
+        reg.line([at(-112.0, my - 2.0 + 2.0 * k), at(-74.0, my - 2.0 + 2.0 * k)], (18, 18, 20), 0.25)
+    reg.text("FAIRCHILD", "arialbd.ttf", 3.6, *at(-93.0, my), (18, 18, 20))
+    reg.text("VIDEO   ENTERTAINMENT   SYSTEM", "arialbd.ttf", 3.4, *at(40.0, my), WHITE)
+    return reg
+
+
+def door():
+    """The cartridge door's face: ribbed."""
+    (x0, x1), (z0, z1) = L.SLOT["x"], L.SLOT["z"]
+    w, h = x1 - x0, z1 - z0
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["door"], w, h, (20, 20, 22))
+    for k in range(11):
+        y = 1.5 + k * (h - 3.0) / 10
+        reg.line([(2.0, y), (w - 2.0, y)], (52, 52, 56), 0.8)
+    return reg
+
+
+def cart():
+    """The Videocart's top: x across, y down from its back end to its front (the grip's ribs); the label showing in
+    front of the slot."""
+    w, length, _ = L.CART["size"]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["cart"], w, length, CART)
+    reg.rect_(8.0, 22.0, w - 8.0, length - 14.0, (16, 16, 18), r=2.0)
+    for k in range(6):
+        y = length - 12.0 + k * 2.0
+        reg.line([(4.0, y), (w - 4.0, y)], (212, 164, 30), 0.6)
+    art = space((440, 168)).convert("RGB")
+    ship(ImageDraw.Draw(art), 120, 86, 2.3, "#FFFFFF", "#FFB23C")
+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = reg.box(12.0, 101.0, w - 12.0, length - 17.0)
+    reg.img.paste(art.resize((round(x1 - x0), round(y1 - y0)), Image.LANCZOS), (round(x0), round(y0)))
+    reg.text("ODYSSEY", "ariblk.ttf", 7.0, w / 2, 95.0, (240, 196, 48))
+    reg.text("VIDEOCART-26", "arialbd.ttf", 3.0, 12.0, 88.0, WHITE, anchor="lm")
+    reg.text("FAIRCHILD", "arialbd.ttf", 3.0, w - 12.0, 88.0, WHITE, anchor="rm")
+    return reg
+
+
+def wood():
+    """Walnut: dark brown, its grain running along."""
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["wood"], 400.0, 160.0, WOOD)
+    rng = random.Random(11)
+    for _ in range(140):
+        y0, tone = rng.uniform(0.0, 160.0), rng.uniform(-0.35, 0.25)
+        colour = tuple(max(0, min(255, round(c * (1 + tone)))) for c in WOOD)
+        wave, phase, width = rng.uniform(0.5, 3.0), rng.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi), rng.uniform(0.4, 1.6)
+        reg.line([(x, y0 + wave * math.sin(x / rng.uniform(30.0, 70.0) + phase)) for x in range(0, 401, 10)], colour,
+                 width)
+    return reg
+
+
+def grip():
+    """A controller's grip: black, ribbed across."""
+    length, _, h = L.CONTROLLER["grip"]
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["grip"], length, h, (14, 14, 16))
+    for k in range(34):
+        x = 8.0 + k * (length - 16.0) / 33
+        reg.line([(x, 3.0), (x, h - 3.0)], (46, 46, 50), 0.9)
+    return reg
+
+
+def main(out):
+    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (L.ATLAS, L.ATLAS), BLACK)
+    for reg in (panel(), strip(), door(), cart(), wood(), grip()):
+        reg.paste(image)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
+    colours = dict(black=BLACK, wood=WOOD, cream=CREAM, yellow=YELLOW, cart=CART, chrome=CHROME, dark=(6, 6, 6),
+                   gloss=(14, 14, 16))
+    for name, (x, y) in L.SWATCHES.items():
+        d.rectangle([x - 12, y - 12, x + 11, y + 11], fill=colours[name])
+    path = os.path.join(out, "channelf_print.png")
+    image.save(path, optimize=True)
+    print(path)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1])
