+    for side in (-1, 1):                                  # the hood's ends, sloping in from the slab's ends
+        e = side * L.WIDTH / 2
+        outline = [(e, top), (e + side * 20.0, top), (e + side * 20.0, L.HEIGHT + 10.0), (e - side * reach, L.HEIGHT + 10.0)]
+        cutter = solid("end", [[(x, y, z) for x, z in outline] for y in (-5.0, L.DEPTH + 5.0)], m["case"])
+        boolean(body, cutter)
+    r = L.RIBS
+    boolean(body, join([box("rib", x0, x1, 10.0, L.DEPTH - 10.0, z - r["width"] / 2, z + r["width"] / 2, m["dark"])
+                        for z in r["z"] for x0, x1 in ((L.WIDTH / 2 - r["depth"], L.WIDTH / 2 + 5.0),
+                                                        (-L.WIDTH / 2 - 5.0, -L.WIDTH / 2 + r["depth"]))], "ribs"))
+    (x0, x1), (y0, y1), (z0, z1) = L.PANEL["x"], L.PANEL["y"], L.PANEL["z"]
+    boolean(body, prism_x("panel", [(y0, z0), (y1, z1), (y1, L.HEIGHT + 20.0), (y0, L.HEIGHT + 20.0)], x0, x1,
+                          m["case"]))
+    s = L.SLOT
+    boolean(body, box("slot", *s["x"], *s["y"], s["bottom"], L.HEIGHT + 10.0, m["dark"]))
+    p = L.POWER
+    boolean(body, box("power_well", p["x"][0] - 1.0, p["x"][1] + 1.0, -5.0, 4.0, p["z"][0] - 1.0, p["z"][1] + 1.0,
+                      m["dark"]))
+    q = L.PORTS
+    boolean(body, box("ports", *q["x"], -5.0, q["depth"], q["z"][0] - 6.0, q["z"][1], m["dark"]))
+    c = L.CARD
+    boolean(body, box("card", *c["x"], -5.0, c["depth"], c["z"][0] - 6.0, c["z"][1], m["dark"]))
+    paint(body, m["print"], top_uv, lambda cc, n, name: n.z > 0.5 and name == "case")
+    paint(body, m["print"], front_uv, lambda cc, n, name: n.y < -0.9 and cc.z < FRONT_H and cc.y < 12.0)
+    return body
+
+
+def panel_button(name, x0, x1, m):
+    """A button on the red panel, standing off its slope."""
+    (a, b), h = L.BUTTONS["y"], L.BUTTONS["height"]
+    s0, s1 = panel_y(a), panel_y(b)
+    button = solid(name, [[PANEL_FRAME @ Vector((x, s, z)) for x, s in ((x0, s0), (x1, s0), (x1, s1), (x0, s1))]
+                          for z in (-1.0, h)], m["button"])
+    bevel(button, 0.5, segments=1)
+    return button
+
+
+def power_button(m):
+    p = L.POWER
+    button = box("power", p["x"][0], p["x"][1], -p["out"], 4.0, p["z"][0], p["z"][1], m["button"])
+    bevel(button, 0.6, segments=1)
+    return button
+
+
+def flap(m):
+    """The slot's dust flap, its origin on its hinge just behind the slot's front edge: it hangs there, out of the
+    cartridge's way, once swung down."""
+    (x0, x1), (y0, y1) = L.SLOT["x"], L.SLOT["y"]
+    plate = box("flap", x0 + 1.0, x1 - 1.0, y0 + 0.1, y1 - 0.4, L.SLOT["flap"] - 0.8, L.SLOT["flap"], m["print"])
+    paint(plate, m["print"], swatch("grey"), lambda c, n, name: True)
+    hinge = Vector((0.0, y0 + 0.9, L.SLOT["flap"]))
+    plate.data.transform(Matrix.Translation(-hinge))
+    return plate, hinge
+
+
+def cartridge(m):
+    """The cartridge, its bottom's middle at its origin, its front (-y) towards the player: the shell, three grooves
+    under the label, the label."""
+    w, t, h = L.CART["size"]
+    lw, lh = L.CART["label"]
+    shell = box("cartridge", -w / 2, w / 2, -t / 2, t / 2, 0.0, h, m["cart"])
+    bevel(shell, 1.0, segments=2)
+    grooves = [box("groove", -w / 2 - 1.0, w / 2 + 1.0, -t / 2 - 1.0, -t / 2 + 0.5, z - 0.4, z + 0.4, m["dark"])
+               for z in (h - lh - 6.0, h - lh - 8.0, h - lh - 10.0)]
+    boolean(shell, join(grooves, "grooves"))
+    bm = bmesh.new()
+    layer = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")
+    x0, x1, z0, z1 = -lw / 2, lw / 2, h - 2.5 - lh, h - 2.5
+    corners = [(x0, z0), (x1, z0), (x1, z1), (x0, z1)]                  # wound to face -y
+    face = bm.faces.new([bm.verts.new((x, -t / 2 - 0.12, z)) for x, z in corners])
+    label_uv = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["label"], lw, lh)
+    for loop, (x, z) in zip(face.loops, corners):
+        loop[layer].uv = label_uv(x - x0, z1 - z)
+    sticker = new_object("label", bm, m["print"])
+    return join([shell, sticker], "cartridge")
+
+
+# ---- The Control Pad -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def pad_frame():
+    (px, py), turn = L.PAD["at"], L.PAD["turn"]
+    return Matrix.Translation((px, py, 0.0)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(turn), 4, "Z")
+
+
+def pad(m):
+    """The pad's body, at its place: the lower body, the raised block, the D-pad's well, its top printed."""
+    w, d, h = L.PAD["size"]
+    b = L.PAD["block"]
+    body = solid("pad", [[(x, y, z) for x, y in rounded(0.0, 0.0, w, d, 4.0, 3)] for z in (0.0, h - b["height"])],
+                 m["case"])
+    boolean(body, box("block", *b["x"], *b["y"], h - b["height"] - 1.0, h, m["case"]), "UNION")
+    bevel(body, 1.2, segments=2)
+    x0, x1, y0, y1 = L.PAD["well"]
+    boolean(body, box("well", x0, x1, y0, y1, h - b["height"] - 2.0, h, m["case"]))
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["pad"], w, d)
+    paint(body, m["print"], lambda co: top(co.x + w / 2, d / 2 - co.y), lambda c, n, name: n.z > 0.9)
+    body.data.transform(pad_frame())
+    return body
+
+
+def pad_parts(m):
+    """The D-pad and the two buttons, each its middle at its origin, and where each goes."""
+    w, d, h = L.PAD["size"]
+    top = h - L.PAD["block"]["height"]
+    x0, x1, y0, y1 = L.PAD["well"]
+    cx, cy = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2
+    s, dh = L.PAD["dpad"]["size"], L.PAD["dpad"]["height"]
+    ring = rounded(0.0, 0.0, s, s, 6.0, 3)
+    dpad = solid("dpad", [[(x, y, z) for x, y in ring] for z in (-1.0, dh - 1.5)]
+                 + [[(x * 0.9, y * 0.9, dh) for x, y in ring]], m["button"])
+    bevel(dpad, 0.6, segments=1)
+    parts = [("dpad", dpad, Vector((cx, cy, top - 2.0)))]
+    b = L.PAD["buttons"]
+    for k, x in enumerate(b["x"]):
+        disc = [(b["r"] * math.cos(2 * math.pi * j / 20), b["r"] * math.sin(2 * math.pi * j / 20)) for j in range(20)]
+        button = solid(f"button{k + 1}", [[(xx, yy, z) for xx, yy in disc] for z in (-1.5, b["height"])], m["button"])
+        bevel(button, 0.6, segments=1)
+        parts.append((f"button{k + 1}", button, Vector((x, b["y"], top))))
+    frame = pad_frame()
+    for _, part, _ in parts:
+        part.data.transform(Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(L.PAD["turn"]), 4, "Z"))
+    return [(name, part, frame @ where) for name, part, where in parts]
+
+
+# ---- The focused clip ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def appear(f, f0, f1):
+    return HIDDEN + (1 - HIDDEN) * back_out(phase(f, f0, f1)) if f >= f0 else HIDDEN
+
+
+def tap(f, f0, hold=2):
+    """A press at f0: down in three frames, held, back up in four."""
+    return smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 3)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f0 + 3 + hold, f0 + 7 + hold)))
+
+
+def rock(f, f0, f1):
+    """The D-pad held over from f0 to f1: over in three frames, back in four."""
+    return smooth(phase(f, f0, f0 + 3)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, f1, f1 + 4)))
+
+
+ROCKS = [(62, 72, 0.0, 9.0), (78, 88, 0.0, 9.0), (96, 104, 9.0, 0.0), (136, 148, 0.0, -9.0)]   # f0, f1, pitch, roll
+PRESSES = dict(button1=(110, 120, 156), button2=(128,), pause=(170, 182), power=(42, 196))
+
+
+def timeline(f):
+    # The cartridge: appears over its slot, drops in with a bump; later rises out and goes.
+    if f < 6 or f >= 224:
+        cart = Pose(scale=HIDDEN)
+    elif f < 18:
+        cart = Pose(z=70.0, scale=appear(f, 6, 16))
+    elif f < 30:
+        cart = Pose(z=70.0 * (1 - ease_in(phase(f, 18, 30))))
+    elif f < 204:
+        cart = Pose(squash=0.05 * math.sin(math.pi * phase(f, 30, 36)))
+    else:
+        cart = Pose(z=70.0 * ease_out(phase(f, 204, 216)), scale=max(HIDDEN, 1 - ease_in(phase(f, 214, 224))))
+
+    # The flap swings down as the cartridge comes, and back up once it's gone.
+    swing = -80.0 * smooth(phase(f, 20, 25)) * (1 - smooth(phase(f, 214, 222)))
+    poses = {"cartridge": cart, "flap": Pose(pitch=swing)}
+
+    pitch = roll = 0.0
+    for f0, f1, p, r in ROCKS:
+        t = rock(f, f0, f1)
+        pitch, roll = pitch + p * t, roll + r * t
+    poses["dpad"] = Pose(pitch=pitch, roll=roll)
+    for name, frames in PRESSES.items():
+        d = max(tap(f, f0) for f0 in frames)
+        if name == "power":
+            poses[name] = Pose(y=2.0 * d)
+        elif name == "pause":
+            n = (PANEL_FRAME.to_3x3() @ Vector((0.0, 0.0, -1.0)))
+            poses[name] = Pose(x=n.x * 1.6 * d, y=n.y * 1.6 * d, z=n.z * 1.6 * d)
+        else:
+            poses[name] = Pose(z=-2.0 * d)
+    return poses
+
+
+# ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
+    images, out = os.path.abspath(args[0]), os.path.abspath(args[1])
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.render.fps = L.FPS
+    printed = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "master_system_print.png"))
+    colours = dict(L.COLOURS, print="#FFFFFF")
+    m = {n: material(n, colours[n], r, printed if n == "print" else None) for n, r in ROUGHNESS.items()}
+
+    reset = panel_button("reset", *L.BUTTONS["reset"], m)
+    whole = join([console(m), reset, pad(m)], "mastersystem")
+    pause = panel_button("pause", *L.BUTTONS["pause"], m)
+    power = power_button(m)
+    cover, hinge = flap(m)
+    cart = cartridge(m)
+    parts = pad_parts(m)
+    for obj in [whole, pause, power, cart] + [part for _, part, _ in parts]:
+        for p in obj.data.polygons:
+            p.use_smooth = True
+        obj.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+
+    # The node tree: the root (the view and the fit) holds the set; the set holds the moving parts at their places.
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("mastersystem_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    seat = Vector(((L.SLOT["x"][0] + L.SLOT["x"][1]) / 2, L.SLOT["y"][0] + 1.0 + L.CART["size"][1] / 2,
+                   L.HEIGHT - 1.0 - L.CART["inserted"]))
+    for part, where in [(cover, hinge), (cart, seat)] + [(part, where) for _, part, where in parts]:
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+    for part in (pause, power):
+        part.parent = whole
+    nodes = {"cartridge": cart, "flap": cover, "pause": pause, "power": power, **{name: part for name, part, _ in parts}}
+
+    # The three-quarter view, then the spec's fit of the set at rest, as the root's transform.
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole, pause, power, cover, cart] + [part for _, part, _ in parts]
+    print(f"Master System: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The Sega Master System's measurements, shared by master_system_print.py (which draws its printing) and
+master_system.py (which builds it). Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+
+The first Master System (1986), 365 x 168 x 73 mm (the Computer History Museum's record), with its Control Pad.
+Millimetres: x from the console's middle (left to right), y back from its front edge, z up from the table. The rest was
+measured from photographs on Wikimedia Commons (Evan-Amos's views of the console from each corner, of its pads and of a
+cartridge; a view of it from above with a cartridge in), scaled by its width; the cartridge is the community's
+measured 108 x 69 x 16 mm.
+
+The console: a slab whose front band carries POWER at its left, the two control ports in a recess and the card slot at
+its right, a red stripe along its top edge; on it the hood, its top rising from the stripe to the ridge along the back,
+its ends and back sloping down (the back's slope full of vent holes), ribs along the slab's ends. In the hood's right
+part a red panel is sunk, sloping more gently than the hood, RESET and PAUSE across it and the diagram under them; at
+its back the cartridge slot, its dust flap hinged along its front edge. The Control Pad lies in front of its left end.
+
+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `top` (the whole console seen from above: the hood's lettering and stripe, the red
+panel's printing, the vent holes; planar-mapped onto every face facing up), `front` (the front band seen from in
+front: POWER's label, the ports' and the card slot's legends), `label` (the cartridge's: a made-up game, Odyssey, on
+the red grid), `pad` (the Control Pad's top), and swatches. A region is (x, y, width, height) in pixels.
+"""
+
+ATLAS = 1024
+
+WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT = 365.0, 168.0, 73.0
+BAND = dict(z=(4.0, 28.0), bevel=(8.0, 36.0))     # the front face's bottom and top; the bevel up to the hood's front
+FOOT = 4.0                                         # the base's recessed foot band
+RIDGE = (128.0, 136.0)                             # the hood's flat ridge, along y
+BACK = (DEPTH, 42.0)                               # the back slope's foot, (y, z)
+ENDS = dict(top=34.0, inset=38.0)                  # the hood's ends slope in from the slab's ends to inset at its top
+
+
+def hood_z(y):
+    """The hood's top at y, from the stripe up to the ridge."""
+    (y0, z0), y1 = BAND["bevel"], RIDGE[0]
+    t = min(1.0, max(0.0, (y - y0) / (y1 - y0)))
+    return z0 + (HEIGHT - z0) * t
+
+
+def profile():
+    """The console's side outline, (y, z), anticlockwise seen from the right end."""
+    return [(2.0, 0.0), (DEPTH - 2.0, 0.0), (DEPTH, FOOT), BACK, (RIDGE[1], HEIGHT), (RIDGE[0], HEIGHT), BAND["bevel"],
+            (0.0, BAND["z"][1]), (0.0, FOOT), (2.0, FOOT)]
+
+
+PANEL = dict(x=(4.0, 117.0), y=(10.0, 117.0), z=(33.5, 56.0))   # the red panel: across, along, its height there
+SLOT = dict(x=(5.5, 115.5), y=(117.5, 135.5), bottom=30.0, flap=62.0)   # the cartridge slot; its flap's height
+BUTTONS = dict(reset=(8.0, 30.0), pause=(92.0, 114.0), y=(98.0, 108.0), height=3.0)   # RESET and PAUSE
+RIBS = dict(z=[8.0 + 2.6 * k for k in range(9)], depth=1.4, width=1.2)   # along both ends of the slab
+
+POWER = dict(x=(-145.0, -119.0), z=(7.0, 21.0), out=2.5)
+PORTS = dict(x=(-34.0, 22.0), z=(FOOT, 18.0), depth=7.0, at=(-19.0, 7.0), size=(21.0, 9.0))
+CARD = dict(x=(54.0, 111.0), z=(FOOT, 27.0), depth=9.0, slot=(60.0, 105.0, 13.0, 15.5))
+
+CART = dict(size=(108.0, 16.0, 69.0), label=(102.0, 27.0), inserted=40.0)   # w, thick, tall; its label, w x h
+
+PAD = dict(at=(-125.0, -64.0), size=(115.0, 52.0, 19.0), turn=6.0,   # its middle; w, d, h; turned (degrees)
+           block=dict(x=(10.0, 57.5), y=(6.0, 26.0), height=5.0),      # the raised block at its back right
+           well=(-52.0, -14.0, -18.0, 14.0),                          # the D-pad's well: x0, x1, y0, y1
+           dpad=dict(size=27.0, height=6.0), buttons=dict(x=(19.0, 40.0), y=-9.0, r=6.6, height=3.0),
+           stripes=(-9.0, 8.0, -20.0, 2.0))                           # behind SEGA: x0, x1, y0, y1
+
+COLOURS = dict(case="#1E1E20", dark="#0B0B0C", grey="#5E5F62", red="#C8262C", cart="#232325", button="#151516")
+
+REGIONS = dict(top=(0, 0, 1024, 472), front=(0, 480, 1024, 120), label=(0, 608, 408, 108), pad=(416, 608, 460, 208))
+SWATCHES = dict(dark=(904, 624), grey=(936, 624), red=(968, 624), button=(1000, 624))
+
+FPS = 30
+LENGTH = 240                 # 8 s

+"""The Sega Master System's printing, for the console theme's Master System model (tools/console-models/master_system.py).
+
+Draws its atlas, its regions as master_system_layout.py places them, each in millimetres as the model's planar UVs map
+it: the console's top seen from above (the red stripe, SEGA MASTER SYSTEM/Power Base, the red panel with RESET and
+PAUSE, CARTRIDGE INPUT and the diagram, the back slope's vent holes); its front band seen from in front (POWER's
+label, CONTROL 1 and 2 over the ports, the card slot and CARD INPUT); the cartridge's label (a made-up game, Odyssey,
+on the red grid); the Control Pad's top (CONTROL PAD, the D-pad's well, the SEGA mark, 1 START and 2); and the
+swatches small parts take their colour from. Run it with the system Python (Pillow):
+
+    python tools/console-models/master_system_print.py <out folder>
+
+It writes master_system_print.png there.
+"""
+
+import os
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import master_system_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from retro_pc_print import rgb, shade  # noqa: E402
+from windows_pc_print import FONTS, Region  # noqa: E402
+
+CASE = rgb(L.COLOURS["case"])
+RED = rgb(L.COLOURS["red"])
+GREY = rgb(L.COLOURS["grey"])
+WHITE = (236, 236, 234)
+INK = (14, 14, 15)
+
+
+def sega(reg, x, y, size, fill, outline=None, anchor="lm"):
+    """SEGA's mark: heavy, wide, slanted capitals (an outline round them if given)."""
+    layer = reg.layer()
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    f = ImageFont.truetype(FONTS + "ariblk.ttf", max(1, round(size * reg.sx)))
+    if outline is not None:
+        d.text(reg.p(x, y), "SEGA", font=f, fill=outline + (255,), anchor=anchor, stroke_width=max(1, round(0.3 * reg.sx)),
+               stroke_fill=outline + (255,))
+    d.text(reg.p(x, y), "SEGA", font=f, fill=fill + (255,), anchor=anchor)
+    yc = reg.p(0, y)[1]
+    reg.over(layer.transform(layer.size, Image.AFFINE, (1, 0.2, -0.2 * yc, 0, 1, 0)))
+
+
+def boxed(reg, text, x0, y0, x1, y1, fill, ink, size, outline=None):
+    reg.rect_(x0, y0, x1, y1, fill, outline=outline, width=0.3)
+    reg.text(text, "arial.ttf", size, (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, ink)
+
+
+# ---- The top ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def top():
+    reg = Region(L.REGIONS["top"], L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH, CASE)
+
+    def at(x, y):
+        return x + L.WIDTH / 2, L.DEPTH - y
+    (px0, px1), (py0, py1) = L.PANEL["x"], L.PANEL["y"]
+
+    # The red stripe along the hood's front edge, either side of the panel.
+    for a, b in ((-L.WIDTH / 2, px0), (px1, L.WIDTH / 2)):
+        reg.rect_(*at(a, 10.6), *at(b, 9.6), RED)
+        reg.rect_(*at(a, 12.4), *at(b, 12.0), shade(CASE, 0.18))
+
+    sega(reg, *at(-124.0, 55.0), 8.6, WHITE, outline=(120, 120, 124))
+    reg.text("MASTER SYSTEM/Power Base", "times.ttf", 7.4, *at(-97.0, 54.4), WHITE, anchor="lm")
+
+    # The red panel: RESET and PAUSE across its back, CARTRIDGE INPUT over them, the diagram, the hatching at its front.
+    reg.rect_(*at(px0, py1), *at(px1, py0), RED)
+    by0, by1 = L.BUTTONS["y"]
+    for (a, b), label, lx in ((L.BUTTONS["reset"], "RESET", 0), (L.BUTTONS["pause"], "PAUSE", 1)):
+        x0, x1 = (px0 + 2.0, (px0 + px1) / 2 - 1.0) if lx == 0 else ((px0 + px1) / 2 + 1.0, px1 - 2.0)
+        reg.rect_(*at(x0, by1 + 1.6), *at(x1, by0 - 1.6), INK, r=0.6)
+        tx = (b + x1) / 2 if lx == 0 else (x0 + a) / 2
+        reg.text(label, "arial.ttf", 3.0, *at(tx, (by0 + by1) / 2), WHITE)

+"""The console theme's Mega-CD system model (godot/themes/console/models/systems/segacd.glb): the first Mega-CD with
+the Mega Drive sitting on it.
+
+Built in Blender (mega_cd_layout.py has the measurements, taken from photographs). The Mega-CD is a rounded black box
+on four feet, the glossy panel sunk into its front, the tray's opening behind the door, and the connecting block on its
+right end rising beside the Mega Drive; the Mega Drive is mega_drive.py's own, built by its build() and set on top.
+The tray is the door (MEGA-CD on it) and the plate behind it with the CD's well, hidden in the box until it slides
+out. The printing is two textures: mega_cd_print.py's (the front panel, the door, the CD's two sides, swatches) and
+mega_drive_print.py's (the Mega Drive's top), both drawn into the same folder.
+
+A node tree: a root (the turn to a three-quarter view, TILT_YAW and TILT_PITCH: the right end towards the viewer, the
+top tipped up; then the model spec's fit: standing on y = 0, centred, the largest side 1 m) holding the set; the set
+holding the tray (holding the CD, waiting in its well shrunk to nothing) and the READY and ACCESS lights (shrunk to
+nothing).
+
+The `focused` clip (8 s, looping) plays a CD: the tray slides out, the CD drops into its well, the tray takes it in;
+READY lights and ACCESS flickers while it loads; later the tray slides out again, the CD lifts off and goes, and the
+tray goes back.
+
+Seven materials (the Mega Drive's print, gloss, dark and reset; case, cd_print, disc) and two textures, within the
+system model budget. Run from the repo root:
+
+    python tools/console-models/mega_drive_print.py artifacts/segacd
+    python tools/console-models/mega_cd_print.py artifacts/segacd
+    blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/console-models/mega_cd.py -- artifacts/segacd godot/themes/console/models/systems/segacd.glb
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Matrix, Vector
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import mega_cd_layout as L  # noqa: E402
+from amiga import paint, rounded, solid  # noqa: E402
+from clip import HIDDEN, Pose, back_out, ease_in, ease_out, key, phase, smooth  # noqa: E402
+from mega_drive import build as mega_drive  # noqa: E402
+from mega_drive_cartridge import bevel, boolean, box, export, join, material, triangles  # noqa: E402
+
+TILT_YAW = -25.0     # degrees about the vertical: the right end comes towards the viewer
+TILT_PITCH = 28.0    # degrees about the horizontal: the top tips up towards the viewer
+
+
+def atlas_uv(region, w, h):
+    rx, ry, rw, rh = region
+    return lambda a, b: ((rx + a / w * rw) / L.ATLAS, 1 - (ry + b / h * rh) / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def swatch(name):
+    x, y = L.SWATCHES[name]
+    return lambda co: (x / L.ATLAS, 1 - y / L.ATLAS)
+
+
+def prism(name, outline, z0, z1, mat):
+    return solid(name, [[(x, y, z) for x, y in outline] for z in (z0, z1)], mat)
+
+
+def circle(cx, cy, r, n=24):
+    return [(cx + r * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / n), cy + r * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / n)) for k in range(n)]
+
+
+def mega_cd(m):
+    """The Mega-CD: the box on its feet, the front panel's recess and the tray's opening, the connecting block; its
+    front printed."""
+    w, d = L.WIDTH, L.DEPTH
+    body = prism("segacd", rounded(0.0, 0.0, w, d, 10.0, 4), L.FOOT, L.HEIGHT, m["case"])
+    bevel(body, 3.0, segments=2)
+    b = L.BLOCK
+    lower = box("block", b["x"][0], b["x"][1], *b["y"], L.FOOT + 2.0, L.HEIGHT, m["case"])
+    upper = box("block_top", b["inner"], b["x"][1], *b["y"], L.HEIGHT - 2.0, b["top"], m["case"])
+    block = join([lower, upper], "block")
+    boolean(body, block, "UNION")
+    bevel(body, 1.5, segments=1, angle=50)
+    p = L.PANEL
+    (x0, x1), (z0, z1) = p["x"], p["z"]
+    face = rounded((x0 + x1) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2, x1 - x0, z1 - z0, (z1 - z0) / 2 - 0.1, 6)
+    boolean(body, solid("panel", [[(x, y, z) for x, z in face] for y in (L.FRONT_Y - 5.0, L.FRONT_Y + p["depth"])],
+                        m["gloss"]))
+    dr = L.DOOR
+    boolean(body, box("opening", dr["x"][0] - 0.5, dr["x"][1] + 0.5, L.FRONT_Y - 5.0, L.FRONT_Y + L.TRAY["depth"] + 10.0,
+                      dr["z"][0] - 0.5, dr["z"][1] + 0.5, m["gloss"]))
+    front = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["front"], x1 - x0, z1 - z0)
+    paint(body, m["cd_print"], lambda co: front(co.x - x0, z1 - co.z),
+          lambda c, n, name: n.y < -0.9 and abs(c.y - (L.FRONT_Y + p["depth"])) < 0.3)
+    feet = []
+    for sx in (-1, 1):
+        for sy in (-1, 1):
+            foot = prism("foot", rounded(sx * (w / 2 - 34.0), sy * (d / 2 - 30.0), 52.0, 40.0, 10.0, 3), 0.0,
+                         L.FOOT + 1.0, m["case"])
+            feet.append(foot)
+    return join([body] + feet, "segacd")
+
+
+def tray(m):
+    """The tray, its origin at its door's middle: the door (MEGA-CD on it) and the plate behind it with the CD's well;
+    and where the CD's middle sits, in its frame."""
+    dr, t = L.DOOR, L.TRAY
+    door = box("tray", *dr["x"], L.FRONT_Y + L.PANEL["depth"] - dr["out"], L.FRONT_Y + L.PANEL["depth"] + 2.0,
+               *dr["z"], m["case"])
+    bevel(door, 0.6, segments=1)
+    face = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["door"], dr["x"][1] - dr["x"][0], dr["z"][1] - dr["z"][0])
+    paint(door, m["cd_print"], lambda co: face(co.x - dr["x"][0], dr["z"][1] - co.z), lambda c, n, name: n.y < -0.9)
+    y0 = L.FRONT_Y + L.PANEL["depth"] + 2.0
+    plate = box("plate", dr["x"][0] + 1.0, dr["x"][1] - 1.0, y0, y0 + t["depth"], *t["z"], m["gloss"])
+    wy, wr = t["well"]
+    cx = (dr["x"][0] + dr["x"][1]) / 2
+    boolean(plate, prism("well", circle(cx, y0 + wy, wr + 0.6, 48), t["z"][1] - 1.6, t["z"][1] + 2.0, m["gloss"]))
+    paint(plate, m["cd_print"], swatch("dark"), lambda c, n, name: True)
+    part = join([door, plate], "tray")
+    middle = Vector((cx, L.FRONT_Y + L.PANEL["depth"], (dr["z"][0] + dr["z"][1]) / 2))
+    part.data.transform(Matrix.Translation(-middle))
+    seat = Vector((cx, y0 + wy, t["z"][1] - 1.6 + L.DISC["thickness"] / 2 + 0.1)) - middle
+    return part, middle, seat
+
+
+def disc(m):
+    r, t = L.DISC["r"], L.DISC["thickness"]
+    part = prism("disc", circle(0.0, 0.0, r, 48), -t / 2, t / 2, m["disc"])
+    top = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["disc"], 2 * r, 2 * r)
+    bottom = atlas_uv(L.REGIONS["data"], 2 * r, 2 * r)
+    paint(part, m["disc"], lambda co: top(co.x + r, r - co.y), lambda c, n, name: n.z > 0.9)
+    paint(part, m["disc"], lambda co: bottom(co.x + r, r + co.y), lambda c, n, name: n.z <= 0.9)
+    return part
+
+
+def light(m, name, colour):
+    x, z = L.LIGHTS[name]
+    pw, ph = L.LIGHTS["size"]
+    y = L.FRONT_Y + L.PANEL["depth"] - 0.25
+    part = box(name, x - pw / 2 + 2.0, x + pw / 2 - 2.0, y - 0.3, y, z - ph / 2 - 2.2, z - ph / 2 - 0.8, m["cd_print"])
+    paint(part, m["cd_print"], swatch(colour), lambda c, n, _name: True)
+    middle = Vector((x, y - 0.15, z - ph / 2 - 1.5))       # a lit bar under its legend
+    part.data.transform(Matrix.Translation(-middle))
+    return part, middle
+
+
+# ---- The focused clip ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def appear(f, f0, f1):
+    return HIDDEN + (1 - HIDDEN) * back_out(phase(f, f0, f1)) if f >= f0 else HIDDEN
+
+
+def out(f):
+    if f < 60:
+        return smooth(phase(f, 8, 26))
+    if f < 186:
+        return 1 - smooth(phase(f, 44, 60))
+    if f < 218:
+        return smooth(phase(f, 188, 204))
+    return 1 - smooth(phase(f, 220, 236))
+
+
+def timeline(f):
+    if f < 26 or f >= 218:
+        cd = Pose(scale=HIDDEN)
+    elif f < 32:
+        cd = Pose(z=50.0, scale=appear(f, 26, 31))
+    elif f < 42:
+        cd = Pose(z=50.0 * (1 - ease_in(phase(f, 32, 42))))
+    elif f < 206:
+        cd = Pose()
+    else:
+        cd = Pose(z=50.0 * ease_out(phase(f, 206, 212)), scale=max(HIDDEN, 1 - ease_in(phase(f, 210, 218))))
+    reading = (64 <= f < 120 or 150 <= f < 160) and (f // 3) % 4 != 3
+    return {"tray": Pose(y=-L.TRAY["travel"] * out(f)), "disc": cd,
+            "ready": Pose() if 62 <= f < 186 else Pose(scale=HIDDEN), "access": Pose() if reading else Pose(scale=HIDDEN)}
+
+
+# ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
+    images, out_path = os.path.abspath(args[0]), os.path.abspath(args[1])
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.render.fps = L.FPS
+    md_print = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "megadrive_print.png"))
+    cd_print = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(images, "mega_cd_print.png"))
+    m = {
+        "print": material("print", "#FFFFFF", 0.55, md_print),
+        "gloss": material("gloss", "#FFFFFF", 0.18, md_print),
+        "dark": material("dark", "#060607", 0.9),
+        "reset": material("reset", "#C4C5BC", 0.5),
+        "case": material("case", L.COLOURS["case"], 0.5),
+        "cd_print": material("cd_print", "#FFFFFF", 0.25, cd_print),
+        "disc": material("disc", "#FFFFFF", 0.2, cd_print),
+    }
+    m_cd = dict(m, gloss=m["cd_print"])                     # the Mega-CD's glossy parts take the panel's printing
+
+    md = mega_drive(m)
+    md.data.transform(Matrix.Translation((0.0, L.MD_BACK, L.MD_LIFT)))
+    base = mega_cd(m_cd)
+    paint(base, m["cd_print"], swatch("dark"), lambda c, n, name: name == "cd_print" and abs(n.y) < 0.5)
+    whole = join([base, md], "segacd")
+    for poly in whole.data.polygons:
+        poly.use_smooth = True
+    whole.data.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(35))
+    drawer, drawer_at, seat = tray(m_cd)
+    cd = disc(m)
+    lights = {"ready": light(m, "ready", "green"), "access": light(m, "access", "red")}
+
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("segacd_root", None)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(root)
+    whole.parent = root
+    drawer.parent = whole
+    drawer.location = drawer_at
+    cd.parent = drawer
+    cd.location = seat
+    for part, where in lights.values():
+        part.parent = whole
+        part.location = where
+    nodes = {"tray": drawer, "disc": cd, **{name: part for name, (part, _) in lights.items()}}
+
+    tilt = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_PITCH), 4, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(TILT_YAW), 4, "Z")
+    points = [tilt @ v.co for v in whole.data.vertices]
+    lo = Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    hi = Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
+    size = hi - lo
+    root.matrix_world = Matrix.Scale(1 / max(size), 4) @ Matrix.Translation((-(lo.x + hi.x) / 2, -(lo.y + hi.y) / 2,
+                                                                             -lo.z)) @ tilt
+
+    key("focused", nodes, timeline, L.LENGTH)
+    meshes = [whole, drawer, cd] + [part for part, _ in lights.values()]
+    print(f"Mega-CD: {sum(triangles(o.data) for o in meshes)} triangles ({triangles(whole.data)} the set), "
+          f"{len({mat.name for o in meshes for mat in o.data.materials})} materials, "
+          f"size {size.x:.1f} x {size.y:.1f} x {size.z:.1f} mm tilted, before the fit")
+    export([root] + meshes, out_path, animations=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+Plain Python: Blender's Python imports it too.
+

+mm, its feet included, measured from photographs on Wikimedia Commons (Evan-Amos's views of the Mega-CD alone and with
+its Mega Drive, and two views of the set from the front and the front right), scaled by the Mega Drive's 280 mm width.
+
+The Mega-CD: a black box on four feet, a glossy panel sunk into its front (the tray's door with MEGA-CD at the left,
+SEGA under it; the READY, compact disc and ACCESS panel at the right, the four lights' legends under it), and the
+connecting block on its right end, rising beside the Mega Drive. The Mega Drive sits on its top, its front over the
+Mega-CD's.

+One texture (ATLAS square, REGIONS): `front` (the Mega-CD's front panel, seen from in front), `door` (the tray's door),

+own. A region is (x, y, width, height) in pixels.
